ko.title: 2027년 COLA 점검: 사회보장 연금 인상액이 실제보다 적게 느껴지는 이유

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for a single percentage: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA.
segments.tr: 매년 가을, 수백만 명의 사회보장 연금 수급자들은 하나의 수치를 기다립니다. 바로 생활비 조정액(COLA)입니다.

segments.src: It is meant to help benefits keep pace with rising prices.
segments.tr: 이는 물가 상승에 맞춰 연금액을 유지하기 위한 것입니다.

segments.src: Yet many retirees open their first statement of the new year and feel the increase has already vanished.
segments.tr: 하지만 많은 은퇴자가 새해 첫 연금 명세서를 확인하고는 인상분이 이미 사라졌다고 느낍니다.

segments.src: This guide explains how the COLA is calculated, why the number on the headline is not the same as the change in your bank deposit, and what to review before January.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 COLA가 어떻게 계산되는지, 왜 뉴스에 나오는 수치와 실제 은행 입금액의 변화가 다른지, 그리고 1월 전에 무엇을 검토해야 하는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not personal financial, tax, or legal advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며, 개인적인 재무, 세무 또는 법률 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Medicare for figures that apply to you.*
segments.tr: 본인에게 적용되는 수치는 사회보장국(SSA)과 메디케어(Medicare)를 통해 확인하십시오.*

segments.src: ## How the COLA Is Calculated
segments.tr: ## COLA 계산 방법

segments.src: The COLA is tied to inflation, but not the version most people see in the news.
segments.tr: COLA는 인플레이션과 연동되어 있지만, 뉴스에서 흔히 보는 물가 지수와는 다릅니다.

segments.src: By law, it is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, known as CPI-W, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
segments.tr: 법에 따라 노동통계국(Bureau of Labor Statistics)에서 발표하는 도시 임금 근로자 및 사무직 근로자 소비자 물가 지수(CPI-W)를 기준으로 합니다.

segments.src: The basic steps are:
segments.tr: 기본 단계는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. The SSA averages the CPI-W for July, August, and September of the current year.
segments.tr: 1. SSA는 당해 연도 7월, 8월, 9월의 CPI-W 평균을 산출합니다.

segments.src: 2. It compares that average with the same three-month average from the previous year.
segments.tr: 2. 이 평균치를 전년도의 동일한 3개월 평균치와 비교합니다.

segments.src: 3. The percentage increase, rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent, becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. 소수점 첫째 자리까지 반올림한 인상률이 COLA가 됩니다.

segments.src: 4. If prices did not rise, there is no COLA. Benefits are not cut in that case.
segments.tr: 4. 물가가 오르지 않았다면 COLA는 없습니다. 이 경우 연금액이 삭감되지는 않습니다.

segments.src: The new rate is announced in October and applies to benefits starting with the January payment.
segments.tr: 새로운 요율은 10월에 발표되며 1월 지급분부터 적용됩니다.

segments.src: For people who receive Social Security, the increase shows up in the payment received in January.
segments.tr: 사회보장 연금을 받는 사람들에게는 1월에 받는 지급액에 인상분이 반영됩니다.

segments.src: For Supplemental Security Income (SSI), the higher payment arrives at the start of January.
segments.tr: 보충적 보장 소득(SSI) 수급자의 경우, 인상된 금액이 1월 초에 지급됩니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Raise Can Feel Smaller
segments.tr: ## 인상액이 적게 느껴지는 이유

segments.src: ### 1. Medicare Part B premiums are usually deducted first
segments.tr: ### 1. 메디케어 파트 B 보험료가 보통 먼저 공제됩니다

segments.src: Most retirees on Medicare pay the Part B premium, and for those who collect Social Security it is typically taken straight out of the monthly benefit.
segments.tr: 메디케어 가입 은퇴자 대부분은 파트 B 보험료를 납부하며, 사회보장 연금을 받는 경우 일반적으로 매월 연금에서 직접 공제됩니다.

segments.src: When the premium rises, the net increase shrinks.
segments.tr: 보험료가 오르면 실질 인상액은 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: Part B premiums have climbed in recent years.
segments.tr: 파트 B 보험료는 최근 몇 년간 상승했습니다.

segments.src: For reference, the standard monthly premium was $185.00 in 2025 and $202.90 in 2026.
segments.tr: 참고로, 표준 월 보험료는 2025년에 $185.00, 2026년에 $202.90였습니다.

segments.src: The 2027 amount is set by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), so confirm the current figure on Medicare.gov.
segments.tr: 2027년 금액은 메디케어 및 메디케이드 서비스 센터(CMS)에서 결정하므로, Medicare.gov에서 현재 수치를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: A simple example with made-up numbers: a retiree receives $2,000 a month before deductions.
segments.tr: 가상의 숫자를 사용한 간단한 예시입니다: 한 은퇴자가 공제 전 월 $2,000를 받습니다.

segments.src: A 3% COLA adds $60.
segments.tr: 3%의 COLA가 적용되면 $60가 추가됩니다.

segments.src: If the Part B premium rises by $15 the same month, the real gain is $45, not $60.
segments.tr: 만약 같은 달에 파트 B 보험료가 $15 오른다면, 실제 이득은 $60가 아니라 $45가 됩니다.

segments.src: ### 2. The "hold harmless" rule has limits
segments.tr: ### 2. "피해 방지(hold harmless)" 규칙에는 한계가 있습니다

segments.src: A federal protection called the hold harmless provision generally prevents a beneficiary's Social Security check from falling because of a Part B premium increase.
segments.tr: 피해 방지 조항이라는 연방 보호책은 일반적으로 파트 B 보험료 인상으로 인해 수급자의 사회보장 연금 수령액이 줄어드는 것을 방지합니다.

segments.src: But it does not apply to everyone.
segments.tr: 하지만 모든 사람에게 적용되지는 않습니다.

segments.src: People who are newly enrolled in Medicare, those who pay higher income-related premiums, and those who do not have the premium deducted from their benefit are generally not covered.
segments.tr: 메디케어에 새로 가입한 사람, 소득 관련 보험료를 더 많이 내는 사람, 연금에서 보험료가 공제되지 않는 사람은 일반적으로 이 보호를 받지 못합니다.

segments.src: It also does not guarantee the COLA will be fully intact, only that the net check will not shrink.
segments.tr: 또한 이 조항은 COLA가 온전히 유지됨을 보장하는 것이 아니라, 최종 수령액이 줄어들지 않음만을 보장합니다.

segments.src: ### 3. Higher-income retirees may pay an income-related surcharge
segments.tr: ### 3. 고소득 은퇴자는 소득 관련 추가 요금을 낼 수 있습니다

segments.src: Some beneficiaries pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA) on top of the standard Part B and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: 일부 수급자는 표준 파트 B 및 파트 D 보험료 외에 소득 관련 월 조정액(IRMAA)을 추가로 납부합니다.

segments.src: It is based on tax returns from two years earlier.
segments.tr: 이는 2년 전 세금 신고서를 기준으로 합니다.

segments.src: A raise in benefits, plus other income, can occasionally push someone into a higher bracket.
segments.tr: 연금 인상과 다른 소득이 합쳐지면 가끔 더 높은 과세 구간으로 올라갈 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 4. Your personal costs may not match CPI-W
segments.tr: ### 4. 개인의 지출 항목이 CPI-W와 다를 수 있습니다

segments.src: CPI-W measures a general basket of goods for working households.
segments.tr: CPI-W는 근로 가구의 일반적인 소비 품목을 측정합니다.

segments.src: Retirees often spend a larger share of income on health care, housing, and utilities.
segments.tr: 은퇴자는 종종 의료비, 주거비, 공과금에 소득의 더 큰 비중을 지출합니다.

segments.src: If those categories rise faster than the overall index, a COLA that matches the headline inflation rate can still feel inadequate.
segments.tr: 만약 이러한 항목의 물가가 전체 지수보다 빠르게 오른다면, 헤드라인 인플레이션율과 일치하는 COLA조차 부족하게 느껴질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Researchers and advocacy groups have long debated whether an index weighted toward older consumers would be more accurate, but the law currently uses CPI-W.
segments.tr: 연구자들과 옹호 단체들은 고령 소비자에 가중치를 둔 지수가 더 정확할지 오랫동안 논의해 왔지만, 현재 법은 CPI-W를 사용합니다.

segments.src: ### 5. Taxes can take a bite
segments.tr: ### 5. 세금이 영향을 줄 수 있습니다

segments.src: Depending on your "combined income" (adjusted gross income, nontaxable interest, and half of your Social Security benefits), up to 85% of your benefit may be subject to federal income tax.
segments.tr: 귀하의 "합산 소득"(조정 총소득, 비과세 이자, 사회보장 연금의 절반)에 따라 연금의 최대 85%까지 연방 소득세가 부과될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The income thresholds are not indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: 소득 기준액은 인플레이션에 연동되지 않습니다.

segments.src: As benefits rise with COLAs over time, more retirees can find a portion of their benefit taxed.
segments.tr: 시간이 지나면서 COLA로 연금이 오르면, 더 많은 은퇴자가 연금의 일부에 대해 세금을 내야 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Some states also tax benefits, though most do not.
segments.tr: 일부 주에서는 연금에 세금을 부과하기도 하지만, 대부분은 그렇지 않습니다.

segments.src: ### 6. Other deductions and premiums
segments.tr: ### 6. 기타 공제 및 보험료

segments.src: Medicare Part D drug plan premiums, Medicare Advantage plan premiums, supplemental (Medigap) policy premiums, and deductibles often change at the start of the year.
segments.tr: 메디케어 파트 D 약제 보험료, 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜 보험료, 보충(Medigap) 보험료 및 공제액은 종종 연초에 변경됩니다.

segments.src: Not all of these come out of the Social Security check, but they affect your total budget.
segments.tr: 이 모든 것이 사회보장 연금에서 공제되는 것은 아니지만, 전체 예산에는 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: ## A January Checklist
segments.tr: ## 1월 체크리스트

segments.src: Use the weeks before the new year to review the details:
segments.tr: 새해가 되기 전 몇 주 동안 다음 세부 사항을 검토하십시오:

segments.src: - **Find your official notice.** The SSA sends a COLA notice that shows your new gross benefit, the Part B premium withheld, and your net payment. Many people can view it in their online *my Social Security* account.
segments.tr: - **공식 통지서를 찾으십시오.** SSA는 새로운 총 연금액, 원천징수된 파트 B 보험료, 최종 수령액이 기재된 COLA 통지서를 보냅니다. 많은 사람이 온라인 *my Social Security* 계정에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Compare gross and net.** Write down your current deposit and your expected deposit after the Part B premium and any other withholding. This is the number that matters for your monthly budget.
segments.tr: - **총액과 실수령액을 비교하십시오.** 현재 입금액과 파트 B 보험료 및 기타 원천징수액을 제외한 예상 입금액을 적어보십시오. 이것이 월 예산에 중요한 숫자입니다.

segments.src: - **Review your Medicare plan during open enrollment.** The annual Medicare open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7. Compare drug coverage and Medicare Advantage plans, since premiums, copays, and covered drugs can change.
segments.tr: - **공개 등록 기간 동안 메디케어 플랜을 검토하십시오.** 연례 메디케어 공개 등록 기간은 10월 15일부터 12월 7일까지입니다. 보험료, 본인 부담금, 보장 약품이 변경될 수 있으므로 약품 보장 범위와 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜을 비교하십시오.

segments.src: - **Check for IRMAA letters.** If your income dropped because of retirement or another life event, you may be able to request a new determination from the SSA.
segments.tr: - **IRMAA 서신을 확인하십시오.** 은퇴나 기타 인생의 변화로 소득이 줄었다면, SSA에 새로운 산정 요청을 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Adjust tax withholding.** If a larger share of your benefit becomes taxable, consider whether to update withholding using Form W-4V or make estimated payments, so there is no surprise at tax time.
segments.tr: - **세금 원천징수를 조정하십시오.** 연금의 더 많은 부분이 과세 대상이 된다면, 세금 신고 시 당황하지 않도록 Form W-4V를 사용하여 원천징수를 업데이트하거나 추정 납부액을 납부하는 것을 고려하십시오.

segments.src: - **Look at your spending categories.** Track housing, health care, food, and utilities for a few months to see which costs are actually rising for you.
segments.tr: - **지출 항목을 살펴보십시오.** 주거비, 의료비, 식비, 공과금을 몇 달간 추적하여 실제로 어떤 비용이 오르고 있는지 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - **Ask about assistance programs.** Medicare Savings Programs, Extra Help for prescription costs, and state or local assistance may help people with limited income and resources. Your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) offers free counseling.
segments.tr: - **지원 프로그램에 대해 문의하십시오.** 메디케어 저축 프로그램, 처방약 비용에 대한 추가 지원(Extra Help), 주 또는 지역 지원 프로그램이 소득과 자원이 제한된 사람들에게 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 주 건강 보험 지원 프로그램(SHIP)에서 무료 상담을 제공합니다.

segments.src: - **Beware of scams.** The SSA does not call to demand payment or threaten to suspend your benefit over a COLA. Use official channels such as ssa.gov and be wary of unsolicited calls, texts, or emails.
segments.tr: - **사기를 주의하십시오.** SSA는 COLA와 관련하여 전화를 걸어 지불을 요구하거나 연금 지급 중단을 협박하지 않습니다. ssa.gov와 같은 공식 채널을 이용하고, 원치 않는 전화, 문자, 이메일은 주의하십시오.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The COLA is an important protection against inflation, and it adjusts every year without an application.
segments.tr: COLA는 인플레이션에 대한 중요한 보호 장치이며, 신청 없이 매년 조정됩니다.

segments.src: But the headline percentage is a starting point, not the final answer.
segments.tr: 하지만 헤드라인의 인상률은 시작점일 뿐, 최종 답안은 아닙니다.

segments.src: What lands in your account depends on Medicare premiums, taxes, and how your own expenses compare with the national index.
segments.tr: 계좌에 들어오는 금액은 메디케어 보험료, 세금, 그리고 본인의 실제 지출이 국가 지수와 어떻게 비교되는지에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: Review your official notice, compare your net deposit with your real costs, and use the fall enrollment season to look for savings.
segments.tr: 공식 통지서를 검토하고, 실수령액과 실제 비용을 비교하며, 가을 등록 시즌을 활용해 절약 방법을 찾으십시오.

segments.src: A few hours of checking now can make the January change far less of a surprise.
segments.tr: 지금 몇 시간을 투자해 확인하는 것만으로도 1월의 변화를 훨씬 덜 당혹스럽게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *Figures and rules can change.
segments.tr: *수치와 규칙은 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Confirm the current COLA, Medicare premiums, and thresholds with the Social Security Administration (ssa.gov) and Medicare (medicare.gov).*
segments.tr: 현재의 COLA, 메디케어 보험료, 기준액은 사회보장국(ssa.gov)과 메디케어(medicare.gov)를 통해 확인하십시오.*

segments.src: ## How the COLA Is Calculated
segments.tr: ## COLA 是如何计算的

segments.src: The COLA is tied to inflation, but not the version most people see in the news.
segments.tr: COLA 与通货膨胀挂钩，但并非大多数人在新闻中看到的那个通胀版本。

segments.src: By law, it is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, known as CPI-W, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
segments.tr: 根据法律，它是基于劳工统计局发布的“城镇工资收入者和文职人员消费者价格指数”（简称 CPI-W）。

segments.src: The basic steps are:
segments.tr: 基本步骤如下：

segments.src: 1. The SSA averages the CPI-W for July, August, and September of the current year.
segments.tr: 1. SSA 计算当前年份 7 月、8 月和 9 月 CPI-W 的平均值。

segments.src: 2. It compares that average with the same three-month average from the previous year.
segments.tr: 1. 将该平均值与前一年相同的三个月平均值进行比较。

segments.src: 3. The percentage increase, rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent, becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 1. 增加的百分比四舍五入到最接近的十分之一，即成为 COLA。

segments.src: 4. If prices did not rise, there is no COLA. Benefits are not cut in that case.
segments.tr: 1. 如果物价没有上涨，则没有 COLA。在这种情况下，福利不会被削减。

segments.src: The new rate is announced in October and applies to benefits starting with the January payment.
segments.tr: 新税率于 10 月公布，适用于从 1 月付款开始的福利。

segments.src: For people who receive Social Security, the increase shows up in the payment received in January.
segments.tr: 对于领取社会保障金的人，增加的金额体现在 1 月份收到的付款中。

segments.src: For Supplemental Security Income (SSI), the higher payment arrives at the start of January.
segments.tr: 对于补充保障收入（SSI），更高的付款将在 1 月初到达。

segments.src: ## Why the Raise Can Feel Smaller
segments.tr: ## 为什么上涨金额让人感觉更少

segments.src: ### 1. Medicare Part B premiums are usually deducted first
segments.tr: ### 1. Medicare Part B 保费通常会先被扣除

segments.src: Most retirees on Medicare pay the Part B premium, and for those who collect Social Security it is typically taken straight out of the monthly benefit.
segments.tr: 大多数参加 Medicare 的退休人员都要缴纳 Part B 保费，而对于那些领取社会保障金的人来说，这通常直接从每月福利中扣除。

segments.src: When the premium rises, the net increase shrinks.
segments.tr: 当保费上涨时，净增加额就会缩小。

segments.src: Part B premiums have climbed in recent years.
segments.tr: 近年来，Part B 的保费一直在攀升。

segments.src: For reference, the standard monthly premium was $185.00 in 2025 and $202.90 in 2026.
The 2027 amount is set by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), so confirm the current figure on Medicare.gov.
segments.tr: 2027 年的金额由美国联邦医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）制定，因此请在 Medicare.gov 上确认最新数据。

segments.src: A simple example with made-up numbers: a retiree receives $2,000 a month before deductions.
segments.tr: 举个用虚构数字说明的简单例子：一位退休人员在扣除前的月福利为 $2,000。

segments.src: A 3% COLA adds $60.
segments.tr: 3% 的 COLA 会增加 $60。

segments.src: If the Part B premium rises by $15 the same month, the real gain is $45, not $60.
segments.tr: 如果 Part B 保费在同月上涨 $15，则实际收益为 $45，而不是 $60。

segments.src: ### 2. The "hold harmless" rule has limits
segments.tr: ### 2. “免受损失”（Hold Harmless）条款具有局限性

segments.src: A federal protection called the hold harmless provision generally prevents a beneficiary's Social Security check from falling because of a Part B premium increase.
segments.tr: 一项名为“免受损失”条款的联邦保护通常可防止受益人的社会保障金因 Part B 保费增加而减少。

segments.src: But it does not apply to everyone.
segments.tr: 但它并不适用于每个人。

segments.src: People who are newly enrolled in Medicare, those who pay higher income-related premiums, and those who do not have the premium deducted from their benefit are generally not covered.
segments.tr: 新近注册 Medicare 的人、支付与收入相关的更高保费的人以及未从其福利中扣除保费的人通常不受覆盖。

segments.src: It also does not guarantee the COLA will be fully intact, only that the net check will not shrink.
segments.tr: 它也不能保证 COLA 完全不受影响，只能保证实收支票不会缩小。

segments.src: ### 3. Higher-income retirees may pay an income-related surcharge
segments.tr: ### 3. 高收入退休人员可能需要支付与收入相关的附加费

segments.src: Some beneficiaries pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA) on top of the standard Part B and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: 一些受益人在标准 Part B 和 Part D 保费之外还要支付与收入相关的每月调整金额（IRMAA）。

segments.src: It is based on tax returns from two years earlier.
segments.tr: 它是基于两年前的纳税申报表计算的。

segments.src: A raise in benefits, plus other income, can occasionally push someone into a higher bracket.
segments.tr: 福利的增加再加上其他收入，偶尔可能会使人跨入更高的档次。

segments.src: ### 4. Your personal costs may not match CPI-W
segments.tr: ### 4. 您的个人支出可能与 CPI-W 不匹配

segments.src: CPI-W measures a general basket of goods for working households.
segments.tr: CPI-W 衡量的是在职家庭的通用一揽子商品。

segments.src: Retirees often spend a larger share of income on health care, housing, and utilities.
segments.tr: 退休人员往往将更大份额的收入花在医疗保健、住房和实用事业上。

segments.src: If those categories rise faster than the overall index, a COLA that matches the headline inflation rate can still feel inadequate.
segments.tr: 如果这些类别的上涨速度快于整体指数，即使与头条通货膨胀率相匹配的 COLA 仍会让人感到不足。

segments.src: Researchers and advocacy groups have long debated whether an index weighted toward older consumers would be more accurate, but the law currently uses CPI-W.
segments.tr: 研究人员和倡导团体长期以来一直在争论，针对老年消费者赋权的指数是否会更准确，但法律目前使用的是 CPI-W。

segments.src: ### 5. Taxes can take a bite
segments.tr: ### 5. 税收可能会咬上一口

segments.src: Depending on your "combined income" (adjusted gross income, nontaxable interest, and half of your Social Security benefits), up to 85% of your benefit may be subject to federal income tax.
segments.tr: 根据您的“综合收入”（调整后总收入、非征税利息以及您社会保障福利的一半），最高 85% 的福利可能需要缴纳联邦个人所得税。

segments.src: The income thresholds are not indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: 收入门槛并没有根据通货膨胀进行指数化调整。

segments.src: As benefits rise with COLAs over time, more retirees can find a portion of their benefit taxed.
segments.tr: 随着福利随着时间的推移因 COLA 而上升，越来越多的退休人员可能会发现他们的一部分福利被征税。

segments.src: Some states also tax benefits, though most do not.
segments.tr: 一些州也会对福利征税，尽管大多数州并不征收。

segments.src: ### 6. Other deductions and premiums
segments.tr: ### 6. 其他扣除项和保费

segments.src: Medicare Part D drug plan premiums, Medicare Advantage plan premiums, supplemental (Medigap) policy premiums, and deductibles often change at the start of the year.
segments.tr: Medicare Part D 处方药计划保费、Medicare Advantage 计划保费、补充（Medigap）保单保费和免赔额通常会在年初发生变化。

segments.src: Not all of these come out of the Social Security check, but they affect your total budget.
segments.tr: 并非所有这些都来自社会保障支票，但它们会影响您的总预算。

segments.src: ## A January Checklist
segments.tr: ## 1 月份检查清单

segments.src: Use the weeks before the new year to review the details:
segments.tr: 利用新年前的几周时间审查详细信息：

segments.src: - **Find your official notice.** The SSA sends a COLA notice that shows your new gross benefit, the Part B premium withheld, and your net payment. Many people can view it in their online *my Social Security* account.
segments.tr: - **找到您的官方通知。** SSA 会发送一份 COLA 通知，显示您的新毛福利、扣缴的 Part B 保费以及您的净付款额。许多人可以在其在线 *my Social Security* 账户中查看该通知。

segments.src: - **Compare gross and net.** Write down your current deposit and your expected deposit after the Part B premium and any other withholding. This is the number that matters for your monthly budget.
segments.tr: - **比较毛额和净额。** 记录下您当前的存款以及扣除 Part B 保费和任何其他扣缴后的预期存款。这是对您的每月预算至关重要的数字。

segments.src: - **Review your Medicare plan during open enrollment.** The annual Medicare open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7. Compare drug coverage and Medicare Advantage plans, since premiums, copays, and covered drugs can change.
segments.tr: - **在开放注册期间审核您的 Medicare 计划。** 每年的 Medicare 开放注册期为 10 月 15 日至 12 月 7 日。比较药品覆盖范围和 Medicare Advantage 计划，因为保费、自付额和覆盖药品可能会发生变化。

segments.src: - **Check for IRMAA letters.** If your income dropped because of retirement or another life event, you may be able to request a new determination from the SSA.
segments.tr: - **检查 IRMAA 信件。** 如果您的收入因退休或其他重大生活事件而下降，您或许可以向 SSA 申请重新认定。

segments.src: - **Adjust tax withholding.** If a larger share of your benefit becomes taxable, consider whether to update withholding using Form W-4V or make estimated payments, so there is no surprise at tax time.
segments.tr: - **调整预扣税。** 如果您福利中应纳税的份额变大，请考虑是否使用 W-4V 表格更新预扣税或进行预缴税款，以便在报税时不会产生意外。

segments.src: - **Look at your spending categories.** Track housing, health care, food, and utilities for a few months to see which costs are actually rising for you.
segments.tr: - **查看您的支出类别。** 跟踪住房、医疗保健、食品和实用事业几个月，看看对您而言哪些成本实际上在上涨。

segments.src: - **Ask about assistance programs.** Medicare Savings Programs, Extra Help for prescription costs, and state or local assistance may help people with limited income and resources. Your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) offers free counseling.
segments.tr: - **询问援助计划。** Medicare 节约计划、针对处方药成本的 Extra Help 以及州或地方的援助可以帮助收入和资源有限的人。您的州健康保险援助计划（SHIP）提供免费咨询。

segments.src: - **Beware of scams.** The SSA does not call to demand payment or threaten to suspend your benefit over a COLA. Use official channels such as ssa.gov and be wary of unsolicited calls, texts, or emails.
segments.tr: - **谨防诈骗。** SSA 不会打电话要求付款，也不会威胁因 COLA 暂停您的福利。请使用 ssa.gov 等官方渠道，并警惕未经请求的来电、短信或电子邮件。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The COLA is an important protection against inflation, and it adjusts every year without an application.
segments.tr: COLA 是应对通货膨胀的重要保护手段，每年无需申请即可进行调整。

segments.src: But the headline percentage is a starting point, not the final answer.
segments.tr: 但是，头条新闻上的百分比只是一个起点，而不是最终答案。

segments.src: What lands in your account depends on Medicare premiums, taxes, and how your own expenses compare with the national index.
segments.tr: 最终进入您账户的金额取决于 Medicare 保费、税收以及您自己的费用与全国指数的比对情况。

segments.src: Review your official notice, compare your net deposit with your real costs, and use the fall enrollment season to look for savings.
segments.tr: 查看您的官方通知，将您的净存款与实际成本进行比较，并利用秋季注册季节寻找省钱的方法。

segments.src: A few hours of checking now can make the January change far less of a surprise.
segments.tr: 现在花费几个小时进行检查，可以使 1 月份的变化减少许多意外。

segments.src: *Figures and rules can change.
segments.tr: *数据和规则可能会发生变化。

segments.src: Confirm the current COLA, Medicare premiums, and thresholds with the Social Security Administration (ssa.gov) and Medicare (medicare.gov).*
segments.tr: 请向社会保障局（ssa.gov）和 Medicare（medicare.gov）确认最新的 COLA、Medicare 保费和门槛。*

segments.src: ## How the COLA Is Calculated
segments.tr: ## COLA की गणना कैसे की जाती है

segments.src: The COLA is tied to inflation, but not the version most people see in the news.
segments.tr: COLA मुद्रास्फीति से जुड़ा हुआ है, लेकिन उस संस्करण से नहीं जो अधिकांश लोग समाचारों में देखते हैं।

segments.src: By law, it is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, known as CPI-W, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
segments.tr: कानून के अनुसार, यह अर्बन वेज अर्नर्स एंड क्लेरिकल वर्कर्स के लिए उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक पर आधारित है, जिसे CPI-W के रूप में जाना जाता है, जिसे ब्यूरो ऑफ लेबर स्टैटिस्टिक्स द्वारा प्रकाशित किया जाता है।

segments.src: The basic steps are:
segments.tr: मूल कदम हैं:

segments.src: 1. The SSA averages the CPI-W for July, August, and September of the current year.
segments.tr: 1. SSA चालू वर्ष के जुलाई, अगस्त और सितंबर के लिए CPI-W का औसत निकालता है।

segments.src: 2. It compares that average with the same three-month average from the previous year.
segments.tr: 2. यह उस औसत की तुलना पिछले वर्ष के उसी तीन महीने के औसत से करता है।

segments.src: 3. The percentage increase, rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent, becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. प्रतिशत वृद्धि, जिसे निकटतम एक-दहाई प्रतिशत तक गोल किया जाता है, COLA बन जाती है।

segments.src: 4. If prices did not rise, there is no COLA. Benefits are not cut in that case.
segments.tr: 4. यदि कीमतें नहीं बढ़ीं, तो कोई COLA नहीं होता है। उस स्थिति में लाभों में कटौती नहीं की जाती है।

segments.src: The new rate is announced in October and applies to benefits starting with the January payment.
segments.tr: नई दर की घोषणा अक्टूबर में की जाती है और यह जनवरी के भुगतान से शुरू होने वाले लाभों पर लागू होती है।

segments.src: For people who receive Social Security, the increase shows up in the payment received in January.
segments.tr: सोशल सिक्योरिटी प्राप्त करने वाले लोगों के लिए, यह वृद्धि जनवरी में प्राप्त भुगतान में दिखाई देती है।

segments.src: For Supplemental Security Income (SSI), the higher payment arrives at the start of January.
segments.tr: सप्लीमेंटल सिक्योरिटी इनकम (SSI) के लिए, बढ़ा हुआ भुगतान जनवरी की शुरुआत में आता है।

segments.src: ## Why the Raise Can Feel Smaller
segments.tr: ## बढ़ोतरी कम क्यों लग सकती है

segments.src: ### 1. Medicare Part B premiums are usually deducted first
segments.tr: ### 1. मेडिकेयर पार्ट B के प्रीमियम आमतौर पर पहले काटे जाते हैं

segments.src: Most retirees on Medicare pay the Part B premium, and for those who collect Social Security it is typically taken straight out of the monthly benefit.
segments.tr: मेडिकेयर पर अधिकांश सेवानिवृत्त लोग पार्ट B प्रीमियम का भुगतान करते हैं, और जो लोग सोशल सिक्योरिटी लेते हैं, उनके लिए यह आमतौर पर सीधे मासिक लाभ से काट लिया जाता है।

segments.src: When the premium rises, the net increase shrinks.
segments.tr: जब प्रीमियम बढ़ता है, तो शुद्ध वृद्धि घट जाती है।

segments.src: Part B premiums have climbed in recent years.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में पार्ट B के प्रीमियम में बढ़ोतरी हुई है।

segments.src: For reference, the standard monthly premium was $185.00 in 2025 and $202.90 in 2026.
The 2027 amount is set by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), so confirm the current figure on Medicare.gov.
segments.tr: 2027 की राशि सेंटर्स फॉर मेडिकेयर एंड मेडिकेड सर्विसेज (CMS) द्वारा तय की जाती है, इसलिए Medicare.gov पर वर्तमान आंकड़े की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: A simple example with made-up numbers: a retiree receives $2,000 a month before deductions.
segments.tr: काल्पनिक संख्याओं के साथ एक सरल उदाहरण: एक सेवानिवृत्त व्यक्ति को कटौती से पहले प्रति माह $2,000 मिलते हैं।

segments.src: A 3% COLA adds $60.
segments.tr: 3% COLA $60 जोड़ता है।

segments.src: If the Part B premium rises by $15 the same month, the real gain is $45, not $60.
segments.tr: यदि उसी महीने पार्ट B का प्रीमियम $15 बढ़ जाता है, तो वास्तविक लाभ $45 है, $60 नहीं।

segments.src: ### 2. The "hold harmless" rule has limits
segments.tr: ### 2. "होल्ड हार्मलेस" नियम की सीमाएं हैं

segments.src: A federal protection called the hold harmless provision generally prevents a beneficiary's Social Security check from falling because of a Part B premium increase.
segments.tr: "होल्ड हार्मलेस" प्रावधान नामक एक संघीय सुरक्षा आमतौर पर पार्ट B प्रीमियम वृद्धि के कारण किसी लाभार्थी के सोशल सिक्योरिटी चेक को घटने से रोकती है।

segments.src: But it does not apply to everyone.
segments.tr: लेकिन यह हर किसी पर लागू नहीं होता है।

segments.src: People who are newly enrolled in Medicare, those who pay higher income-related premiums, and those who do not have the premium deducted from their benefit are generally not covered.
segments.tr: जो लोग मेडिकेयर में नए नामांकित हैं, जो उच्च आय-संबंधित प्रीमियम का भुगतान करते हैं, और जिनके लाभ से प्रीमियम नहीं काटा जाता है, वे आमतौर पर इसके अंतर्गत नहीं आते हैं।

segments.src: It also does not guarantee the COLA will be fully intact, only that the net check will not shrink.
segments.tr: यह यह भी गारंटी नहीं देता है कि COLA पूरी तरह से बरकरार रहेगा, केवल यह कि शुद्ध चेक नहीं घटेगा।

segments.src: ### 3. Higher-income retirees may pay an income-related surcharge
segments.tr: ### 3. उच्च आय वाले सेवानिवृत्त लोग आय-संबंधित अधिभार का भुगतान कर सकते हैं

segments.src: Some beneficiaries pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA) on top of the standard Part B and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: कुछ लाभार्थी मानक पार्ट B और पार्ट D प्रीमियम के ऊपर आय-संबंधित मासिक समायोजन राशि (IRMAA) का भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: It is based on tax returns from two years earlier.
segments.tr: यह दो साल पहले के टैक्स रिटर्न पर आधारित होता है।

segments.src: A raise in benefits, plus other income, can occasionally push someone into a higher bracket.
segments.tr: लाभों में वृद्धि, साथ ही अन्य आय, कभी-कभी किसी को उच्च ब्रैकेट में धकेल सकती है।

segments.src: ### 4. Your personal costs may not match CPI-W
segments.tr: ### 4. आपकी व्यक्तिगत लागतें CPI-W से मेल नहीं खा सकती हैं

segments.src: CPI-W measures a general basket of goods for working households.
segments.tr: CPI-W कामकाजी परिवारों के लिए वस्तुओं की एक सामान्य टोकरी को मापता है।

segments.src: Retirees often spend a larger share of income on health care, housing, and utilities.
segments.tr: सेवानिवृत्त लोग अक्सर स्वास्थ्य सेवा, आवास और उपयोगिताओं (utilities) पर अपनी आय का एक बड़ा हिस्सा खर्च करते हैं।

segments.src: If those categories rise faster than the overall index, a COLA that matches the headline inflation rate can still feel inadequate.
segments.tr: यदि वे श्रेणियां समग्र सूचकांक की तुलना में तेज़ी से बढ़ती हैं, तो हेडलाइन मुद्रास्फीति दर से मेल खाने वाला COLA भी अपर्याप्त लग सकता है।

segments.src: Researchers and advocacy groups have long debated whether an index weighted toward older consumers would be more accurate, but the law currently uses CPI-W.
segments.tr: शोधकर्ताओं और वकालत समूहों ने लंबे समय से इस बात पर बहस की है कि क्या बुजुर्ग उपभोक्ताओं के प्रति भारित सूचकांक अधिक सटीक होगा, लेकिन कानून वर्तमान में CPI-W का उपयोग करता है।

segments.src: ### 5. Taxes can take a bite
segments.tr: ### 5. कर प्रभाव डाल सकते हैं

segments.src: Depending on your "combined income" (adjusted gross income, nontaxable interest, and half of your Social Security benefits), up to 85% of your benefit may be subject to federal income tax.
segments.tr: आपकी "संयुक्त आय" (समायोजित सकल आय, गैर-कर योग्य ब्याज, और आपके सोशल सिक्योरिटी लाभों का आधा) के आधार पर, आपके लाभ का 85% तक संघीय आयकर के अधीन हो सकता है।

segments.src: The income thresholds are not indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: आय सीमाएं मुद्रास्फीति के साथ अनुक्रमित (indexed) नहीं हैं।

segments.src: As benefits rise with COLAs over time, more retirees can find a portion of their benefit taxed.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे समय के साथ COLA के साथ लाभ बढ़ते हैं, अधिक सेवानिवृत्त लोग अपने लाभ के एक हिस्से पर कर पा सकते हैं।

segments.src: Some states also tax benefits, though most do not.
segments.tr: कुछ राज्य लाभों पर कर भी लगाते हैं, हालांकि अधिकांश ऐसा नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: ### 6. Other deductions and premiums
segments.tr: ### 6. अन्य कटौती और प्रीमियम

segments.src: Medicare Part D drug plan premiums, Medicare Advantage plan premiums, supplemental (Medigap) policy premiums, and deductibles often change at the start of the year.
segments.tr: मेडिकेयर पार्ट D ड्रग प्लान प्रीमियम, मेडिकेयर एडवांटेज प्लान प्रीमियम, सप्लीमेंटल (Medigap) पॉलिसी प्रीमियम और डिडक्टिबल्स अक्सर वर्ष की शुरुआत में बदलते हैं।

segments.src: Not all of these come out of the Social Security check, but they affect your total budget.
segments.tr: ये सभी सोशल सिक्योरिटी चेक से नहीं निकलते हैं, लेकिन वे आपके कुल बजट को प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## A January Checklist
segments.tr: ## जनवरी चेकलिस्ट

segments.src: Use the weeks before the new year to review the details:
segments.tr: विवरणों की समीक्षा के लिए नए साल से पहले के हफ्तों का उपयोग करें:

segments.src: - **Find your official notice.** The SSA sends a COLA notice that shows your new gross benefit, the Part B premium withheld, and your net payment. Many people can view it in their online *my Social Security* account.
segments.tr: - **अपना आधिकारिक नोटिस खोजें।** SSA एक COLA नोटिस भेजता है जो आपका नया सकल लाभ, रोकी गई पार्ट B प्रीमियम, और आपका शुद्ध भुगतान दिखाता है। कई लोग इसे अपने ऑनलाइन *my Social Security* खाते में देख सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Compare gross and net.** Write down your current deposit and your expected deposit after the Part B premium and any other withholding. This is the number that matters for your monthly budget.
segments.tr: - **सकल और शुद्ध की तुलना करें।** अपनी वर्तमान जमा राशि और पार्ट B प्रीमियम व किसी भी अन्य विदहोल्डिंग के बाद अपनी अपेक्षित जमा राशि लिखें। आपके मासिक बजट के लिए यही संख्या मायने रखती है।

segments.src: - **Review your Medicare plan during open enrollment.** The annual Medicare open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7. Compare drug coverage and Medicare Advantage plans, since premiums, copays, and covered drugs can change.
segments.tr: - **ओपन एनरोलमेंट के दौरान अपने मेडिकेयर प्लान की समीक्षा करें।** वार्षिक मेडिकेयर ओपन एनरोलमेंट अवधि 15 अक्टूबर से 7 दिसंबर तक चलती है। दवा कवरेज और मेडिकेयर एडवांटेज योजनाओं की तुलना करें, क्योंकि प्रीमियम, सह-भुगतान (copays) और कवर की गई दवाएं बदल सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Check for IRMAA letters.** If your income dropped because of retirement or another life event, you may be able to request a new determination from the SSA.
segments.tr: - **IRMAA पत्रों की जांच करें।** यदि सेवानिवृत्ति या किसी अन्य जीवन घटना के कारण आपकी आय में गिरावट आई है, तो आप SSA से एक नए निर्धारण का अनुरोध करने में सक्षम हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Adjust tax withholding.** If a larger share of your benefit becomes taxable, consider whether to update withholding using Form W-4V or make estimated payments, so there is no surprise at tax time.
segments.tr: - **टैक्स विदहोल्डिंग समायोजित करें।** यदि आपके लाभ का एक बड़ा हिस्सा कर योग्य हो जाता है, तो इस बात पर विचार करें कि फॉर्म W-4V का उपयोग करके विदहोल्डिंग को अपडेट करना है या अनुमानित भुगतान करना है, ताकि कर के समय कोई आश्चर्य न हो।

segments.src: - **Look at your spending categories.** Track housing, health care, food, and utilities for a few months to see which costs are actually rising for you.
segments.tr: - **अपनी खर्च श्रेणियों को देखें।** यह देखने के लिए कि आपके लिए वास्तव में कौन सी लागतें बढ़ रही हैं, कुछ महीनों के लिए आवास, स्वास्थ्य सेवा, भोजन और उपयोगिताओं को ट्रैक करें।

segments.src: - **Ask about assistance programs.** Medicare Savings Programs, Extra Help for prescription costs, and state or local assistance may help people with limited income and resources. Your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) offers free counseling.
segments.tr: - **सहायता कार्यक्रमों के बारे में पूछें।** मेडिकेयर सेविंग्स प्रोग्राम, प्रिस्क्रिप्शन लागतों के लिए एक्स्ट्रा हेल्प, और राज्य या स्थानीय सहायता सीमित आय और संसाधनों वाले लोगों की मदद कर सकती है। आपका स्टेट हेल्थ इंश्योरेंस असिस्टेंस प्रोग्राम (SHIP) मुफ्त परामर्श प्रदान करता है।

segments.src: - **Beware of scams.** The SSA does not call to demand payment or threaten to suspend your benefit over a COLA. Use official channels such as ssa.gov and be wary of unsolicited calls, texts, or emails.
segments.tr: - **स्कैम से सावधान रहें।** SSA भुगतान की मांग करने या COLA को लेकर आपके लाभ को निलंबित करने की धमकी देने के लिए कॉल नहीं करता है। ssa.gov जैसे आधिकारिक चैनलों का उपयोग करें और अवांछित कॉल, टेक्स्ट या ईमेल से सावधान रहें।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## मुख्य बात

segments.src: The COLA is an important protection against inflation, and it adjusts every year without an application.
segments.tr: COLA मुद्रास्फीति के खिलाफ एक महत्वपूर्ण सुरक्षा है, और यह बिना आवेदन के हर साल समायोजित होता है।

segments.src: But the headline percentage is a starting point, not the final answer.
segments.tr: लेकिन सुर्खियों का प्रतिशत एक शुरुआती बिंदु है, अंतिम उत्तर नहीं।

segments.src: What lands in your account depends on Medicare premiums, taxes, and how your own expenses compare with the national index.
segments.tr: आपके खाते में क्या आता है यह मेडिकेयर प्रीमियम, करों और राष्ट्रीय सूचकांक के साथ आपके अपने खर्चों की तुलना पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: Review your official notice, compare your net deposit with your real costs, and use the fall enrollment season to look for savings.
segments.tr: अपने आधिकारिक नोटिस की समीक्षा करें, अपनी वास्तविक लागतों के साथ अपने शुद्ध जमा की तुलना करें, और बचत की तलाश के लिए गिरावट के नामांकन सत्र का उपयोग करें।

segments.src: A few hours of checking now can make the January change far less of a surprise.
segments.tr: अभी कुछ घंटों की जांच जनवरी के बदलाव को बहुत कम आश्चर्यजनक बना सकती है।

segments.src: *Figures and rules can change.
segments.tr: *आंकड़े और नियम बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: Confirm the current COLA, Medicare premiums, and thresholds with the Social Security Administration (ssa.gov) and Medicare (medicare.gov).*
segments.tr: सोशल सिक्योरिटी एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन (ssa.gov) और मेडिकेयर (medicare.gov) के साथ वर्तमान COLA, मेडिकेयर प्रीमियम और सीमाओं की पुष्टि करें।*

es.title: La revisión del COLA de 2027: por qué un aumento del Seguro Social a menudo parece menor de lo que es

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for a single percentage: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA.
segments.tr: Cada otoño, millones de beneficiarios del Seguro Social esperan un solo porcentaje: el ajuste por costo de vida, o COLA.

segments.src: It is meant to help benefits keep pace with rising prices.
segments.tr: Está diseñado para ayudar a que los beneficios sigan el ritmo del aumento de los precios.

segments.src: Yet many retirees open their first statement of the new year and feel the increase has already vanished.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, muchos jubilados abren su primer estado de cuenta del año nuevo y sienten que el incremento ya se ha desvanecido.

segments.src: This guide explains how the COLA is calculated, why the number on the headline is not the same as the change in your bank deposit, and what to review before January.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica cómo se calcula el COLA, por qué la cifra principal no es la misma que el cambio en su depósito bancario y qué revisar antes de enero.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not personal financial, tax, or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo es información general, no asesoramiento financiero, fiscal o legal personal.

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Medicare for figures that apply to you.*
segments.tr: Consulte a la Administración del Seguro Social (SSA) y a Medicare para conocer las cifras que se aplican a su caso.*

segments.src: ## How the COLA Is Calculated
segments.tr: ## How the COLA Is Calculated

segments.src: The COLA is tied to inflation, but not the version most people see in the news.
segments.tr: El COLA está vinculado a la inflación, pero no a la versión que la mayoría de la gente ve en las noticias.

segments.src: By law, it is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, known as CPI-W, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
segments.tr: Por ley, se basa en el Índice de Precios al Consumidor para Asalariados Urbanos y Trabajadores Clericales, conocido como CPI-W, publicado por la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales.

segments.src: The basic steps are:
segments.tr: Los pasos básicos son:

segments.src: 1. The SSA averages the CPI-W for July, August, and September of the current year.
segments.tr: 1. La SSA promedia el CPI-W para julio, agosto y septiembre del año en curso.

segments.src: 2. It compares that average with the same three-month average from the previous year.
segments.tr: 2. Compara ese promedio con el mismo promedio de tres meses del año anterior.

segments.src: 3. The percentage increase, rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent, becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. El porcentaje de aumento, redondeado a la décima de porcentaje más cercana, se convierte en el COLA.

segments.src: 4. If prices did not rise, there is no COLA. Benefits are not cut in that case.
segments.tr: 4. Si los precios no subieron, no hay COLA. En ese caso, los beneficios no se reducen.

segments.src: The new rate is announced in October and applies to benefits starting with the January payment.
segments.tr: La nueva tarifa se anuncia en octubre y se aplica a los beneficios a partir del pago de enero.

segments.src: For people who receive Social Security, the increase shows up in the payment received in January.
segments.tr: Para las personas que reciben el Seguro Social, el incremento aparece en el pago recibido en enero.

segments.src: For Supplemental Security Income (SSI), the higher payment arrives at the start of January.
segments.tr: Para la Seguridad de Ingreso Suplementario (SSI), el pago más alto llega a principios de enero.

segments.src: ## Why the Raise Can Feel Smaller
segments.tr: ## Por qué el aumento puede sentirse menor

segments.src: ### 1. Medicare Part B premiums are usually deducted first
segments.tr: ### 1. Las primas de la Parte B de Medicare suelen deducirse primero

segments.src: Most retirees on Medicare pay the Part B premium, and for those who collect Social Security it is typically taken straight out of the monthly benefit.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los jubilados en Medicare pagan la prima de la Parte B, y para aquellos que cobran el Seguro Social, generalmente se descuenta directamente del beneficio mensual.

segments.src: When the premium rises, the net increase shrinks.
segments.tr: Cuando la prima aumenta, el incremento neto se reduce.

segments.src: Part B premiums have climbed in recent years.
segments.tr: Las primas de la Parte B han subido en los últimos años.

segments.src: For reference, the standard monthly premium was $185.00 in 2025 and $202.90 in 2026.
segments.tr: Como referencia, la prima mensual estándar fue de $185.00 en 2025 y $202.90 en 2026.

segments.src: The 2027 amount is set by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), so confirm the current figure on Medicare.gov.
segments.tr: El monto para 2027 lo establecen los Centros de Servicios de Medicare y Medicaid (CMS), así que confirme la cifra actual en Medicare.gov.

segments.src: A simple example with made-up numbers: a retiree receives $2,000 a month before deductions.
segments.tr: Un ejemplo simple con números ficticios: un jubilado recibe $2,000 al mes antes de deducciones.

segments.src: A 3% COLA adds $60.
segments.tr: Un COLA del 3% agrega $60.

segments.src: If the Part B premium rises by $15 the same month, the real gain is $45, not $60.
segments.tr: Si la prima de la Parte B aumenta en $15 el mismo mes, la ganancia real es de $45, no de $60.

segments.src: ### 2. The "hold harmless" rule has limits
segments.tr: ### 2. La regla de "inmunidad" tiene límites

segments.src: A federal protection called the hold harmless provision generally prevents a beneficiary's Social Security check from falling because of a Part B premium increase.
segments.tr: Una protección federal llamada disposición de inmunidad (hold harmless) generalmente evita que el cheque del Seguro Social de un beneficiario disminuya debido a un aumento en la prima de la Parte B.

segments.src: But it does not apply to everyone.
segments.tr: Pero no se aplica a todos.

segments.src: People who are newly enrolled in Medicare, those who pay higher income-related premiums, and those who do not have the premium deducted from their benefit are generally not covered.
segments.tr: Las personas que se inscriben recientemente en Medicare, aquellos que pagan primas más altas relacionadas con los ingresos y aquellos a quienes no se les deduce la prima de su beneficio generalmente no están cubiertos.

segments.src: It also does not guarantee the COLA will be fully intact, only that the net check will not shrink.
segments.tr: Tampoco garantiza que el COLA permanezca intacto, solo que el cheque neto no se reduzca.

segments.src: ### 3. Higher-income retirees may pay an income-related surcharge
segments.tr: ### 3. Los jubilados con mayores ingresos pueden pagar un recargo relacionado con los ingresos

segments.src: Some beneficiaries pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA) on top of the standard Part B and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: Algunos beneficiarios pagan un Monto de Ajuste Mensual Basado en los Ingresos (IRMAA) además de las primas estándar de las Partes B y D.

segments.src: It is based on tax returns from two years earlier.
segments.tr: Se basa en las declaraciones de impuestos de dos años antes.

segments.src: A raise in benefits, plus other income, can occasionally push someone into a higher bracket.
segments.tr: Un aumento en los beneficios, sumado a otros ingresos, puede ocasionalmente llevar a alguien a un tramo superior.

segments.src: ### 4. Your personal costs may not match CPI-W
segments.tr: ### 4. Sus costos personales pueden no coincidir con el CPI-W

segments.src: CPI-W measures a general basket of goods for working households.
segments.tr: El CPI-W mide una canasta general de bienes para hogares trabajadores.

segments.src: Retirees often spend a larger share of income on health care, housing, and utilities.
segments.tr: Los jubilados suelen gastar una mayor proporción de sus ingresos en atención médica, vivienda y servicios públicos.

segments.src: If those categories rise faster than the overall index, a COLA that matches the headline inflation rate can still feel inadequate.
segments.tr: Si esas categorías aumentan más rápido que el índice general, un COLA que coincida con la tasa de inflación general aún puede parecer insuficiente.

segments.src: Researchers and advocacy groups have long debated whether an index weighted toward older consumers would be more accurate, but the law currently uses CPI-W.
segments.tr: Los investigadores y los grupos de defensa han debatido durante mucho tiempo si un índice ponderado hacia los consumidores mayores sería más preciso, pero la ley actualmente utiliza el CPI-W.

segments.src: ### 5. Taxes can take a bite
segments.tr: ### 5. Los impuestos pueden mermar sus ingresos

segments.src: Depending on your "combined income" (adjusted gross income, nontaxable interest, and half of your Social Security benefits), up to 85% of your benefit may be subject to federal income tax.
segments.tr: Dependiendo de sus "ingresos combinados" (ingreso bruto ajustado, intereses no imponibles y la mitad de sus beneficios del Seguro Social), hasta el 85% de su beneficio puede estar sujeto al impuesto federal sobre la renta.

segments.src: The income thresholds are not indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: Los umbrales de ingresos no están indexados a la inflación.

segments.src: As benefits rise with COLAs over time, more retirees can find a portion of their benefit taxed.
segments.tr: A medida que los beneficios aumentan con los COLA a lo largo del tiempo, más jubilados pueden ver una porción de su beneficio gravada con impuestos.

segments.src: Some states also tax benefits, though most do not.
segments.tr: Algunos estados también gravan los beneficios, aunque la mayoría no lo hace.

segments.src: ### 6. Other deductions and premiums
segments.tr: ### 6. Otras deducciones y primas

segments.src: Medicare Part D drug plan premiums, Medicare Advantage plan premiums, supplemental (Medigap) policy premiums, and deductibles often change at the start of the year.
segments.tr: Las primas del plan de medicamentos de la Parte D de Medicare, las primas de los planes Medicare Advantage, las primas de pólizas suplementarias (Medigap) y los deducibles a menudo cambian al comienzo del año.

segments.src: Not all of these come out of the Social Security check, but they affect your total budget.
segments.tr: No todas provienen del cheque del Seguro Social, pero afectan su presupuesto total.

segments.src: ## A January Checklist
segments.tr: ## Una lista de verificación para enero

segments.src: Use the weeks before the new year to review the details:
segments.tr: Utilice las semanas anteriores al año nuevo para revisar los detalles:

segments.src: - **Find your official notice.** The SSA sends a COLA notice that shows your new gross benefit, the Part B premium withheld, and your net payment. Many people can view it in their online *my Social Security* account.
segments.tr: - **Busque su notificación oficial.** La SSA envía un aviso de COLA que muestra su nuevo beneficio bruto, la prima de la Parte B retenida y su pago neto. Muchas personas pueden verlo en su cuenta en línea de *my Social Security*.

segments.src: - **Compare gross and net.** Write down your current deposit and your expected deposit after the Part B premium and any other withholding. This is the number that matters for your monthly budget.
segments.tr: - **Compare el bruto y el neto.** Anote su depósito actual y su depósito esperado después de la prima de la Parte B y cualquier otra retención. Este es el número que importa para su presupuesto mensual.

segments.src: - **Review your Medicare plan during open enrollment.** The annual Medicare open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7. Compare drug coverage and Medicare Advantage plans, since premiums, copays, and covered drugs can change.
segments.tr: - **Revise su plan de Medicare durante la inscripción abierta.** El período anual de inscripción abierta de Medicare va del 15 de octubre al 7 de diciembre. Compare la cobertura de medicamentos y los planes Medicare Advantage, ya que las primas, los copagos y los medicamentos cubiertos pueden cambiar.

segments.src: - **Check for IRMAA letters.** If your income dropped because of retirement or another life event, you may be able to request a new determination from the SSA.
segments.tr: - **Verifique si hay cartas de IRMAA.** Si sus ingresos disminuyeron debido a la jubilación u otro evento de la vida, es posible que pueda solicitar una nueva determinación de la SSA.

segments.src: - **Adjust tax withholding.** If a larger share of your benefit becomes taxable, consider whether to update withholding using Form W-4V or make estimated payments, so there is no surprise at tax time.
segments.tr: - **Ajuste la retención de impuestos.** Si una mayor parte de su beneficio se vuelve taxable, considere si debe actualizar la retención usando el Formulario W-4V o hacer pagos estimados, para que no haya sorpresas en la temporada de impuestos.

segments.src: - **Look at your spending categories.** Track housing, health care, food, and utilities for a few months to see which costs are actually rising for you.
segments.tr: - **Revise sus categorías de gastos.** Haga un seguimiento de la vivienda, la atención médica, la comida y los servicios públicos durante unos meses para ver qué costos están aumentando realmente para usted.

segments.src: - **Ask about assistance programs.** Medicare Savings Programs, Extra Help for prescription costs, and state or local assistance may help people with limited income and resources. Your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) offers free counseling.
segments.tr: - **Pregunte sobre los programas de asistencia.** Los Programas de Ahorro de Medicare, la Ayuda Adicional para los costos de recetas y la asistencia estatal o local pueden ayudar a las personas con ingresos y recursos limitados. Su Programa Estatal de Asistencia con el Seguro Médico (SHIP) ofrece asesoramiento gratuito.

segments.src: - **Beware of scams.** The SSA does not call to demand payment or threaten to suspend your benefit over a COLA. Use official channels such as ssa.gov and be wary of unsolicited calls, texts, or emails.
segments.tr: - **Cuidado con las estafas.** La SSA no llama para exigir pagos ni amenaza con suspender su beneficio por un COLA. Utilice canales oficiales como ssa.gov y desconfíe de llamadas, mensajes de texto o correos electrónicos no solicitados.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: The COLA is an important protection against inflation, and it adjusts every year without an application.
segments.tr: El COLA es una protección importante contra la inflación y se ajusta cada año sin necesidad de una solicitud.

segments.src: But the headline percentage is a starting point, not the final answer.
segments.tr: Pero el porcentaje principal es un punto de partida, no la respuesta definitiva.

segments.src: What lands in your account depends on Medicare premiums, taxes, and how your own expenses compare with the national index.
segments.tr: Lo que llega a su cuenta depende de las primas de Medicare, los impuestos y cómo se comparan sus propios gastos con el índice nacional.

segments.src: Review your official notice, compare your net deposit with your real costs, and use the fall enrollment season to look for savings.
segments.tr: Revise su notificación oficial, compare su depósito neto con sus costos reales y aproveche la temporada de inscripción de otoño para buscar ahorros.

segments.src: A few hours of checking now can make the January change far less of a surprise.
segments.tr: Unas pocas horas de revisión ahora pueden hacer que el cambio de enero sea mucho menos sorpresivo.

segments.src: *Figures and rules can change.
segments.tr: *Las cifras y las reglas pueden cambiar.

segments.src: Confirm the current COLA, Medicare premiums, and thresholds with the Social Security Administration (ssa.gov) and Medicare (medicare.gov).*
segments.tr: Confirme el COLA actual, las primas de Medicare y los umbrales con la Administración del Seguro Social (ssa.gov) y Medicare (medicare.gov).*

ar.title: مراجعة تعديل تكلفة المعيشة لعام 2027: لماذا تبدو زيادات الضمان الاجتماعي أصغر مما تبدو عليه غالباً

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for a single percentage: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA.
segments.tr: في كل خريف، ينتظر ملايين المستفيدين من الضمان الاجتماعي نسبة مئوية واحدة: تعديل تكلفة المعيشة، أو (COLA).

segments.src: It is meant to help benefits keep pace with rising prices.
segments.tr: وهو مخصص لمساعدة المزايا على مواكبة ارتفاع الأسعار.

segments.src: Yet many retirees open their first statement of the new year and feel the increase has already vanished.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، يفتح العديد من المتقاعدين كشف حسابهم الأول للعام الجديد ويشعرون أن الزيادة قد اختفت بالفعل.

segments.src: This guide explains how the COLA is calculated, why the number on the headline is not the same as the change in your bank deposit, and what to review before January.
segments.tr: يوضح هذا الدليل كيف يتم حساب تعديل تكلفة المعيشة (COLA)، ولماذا لا يكون الرقم الموجود في العنوان الرئيسي هو نفسه التغيير في رصيد بنكك، وما يجب مراجعته قبل شهر يناير.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not personal financial, tax, or legal advice.
segments.tr: *تعتبر هذه المقالة معلومات عامة، وليست مشورة مالية أو ضريبية أو قانونية شخصية.

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Medicare for figures that apply to you.*
segments.tr: تحقق من إدارة الضمان الاجتماعي (SSA) والرعاية الصحية (Medicare) للأرقام التي تنطبق عليك.*

segments.src: ## How the COLA Is Calculated
segments.tr: ## كيف يتم حساب تعديل تكلفة المعيشة (COLA)

segments.src: The COLA is tied to inflation, but not the version most people see in the news.
segments.tr: يرتبط تعديل تكلفة المعيشة بالتضخم، ولكن ليس بالنسخة التي يراها معظم الناس في الأخبار.

segments.src: By law, it is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, known as CPI-W, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
segments.tr: بموجب القانون، يعتمد على مؤشر أسعار المستهلك للعاملين في الحضر والعاملين في المكاتب، المعروف باسم (CPI-W)، والذي ينشره مكتب إحصاءات العمل.

segments.src: The basic steps are:
segments.tr: الخطوات الأساسية هي:

segments.src: 1. The SSA averages the CPI-W for July, August, and September of the current year.
segments.tr: 1. تقوم إدارة الضمان الاجتماعي (SSA) بحساب متوسط مؤشر (CPI-W) لأشهر يوليو وأغسطس سبتمبر من العام الحالي.

segments.src: 2. It compares that average with the same three-month average from the previous year.
segments.tr: 2. تقارن هذا المتوسط مع نفس المتوسط للأشهر الثلاثة من العام السابق.

segments.src: 3. The percentage increase, rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent, becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. تصبح الزيادة النسبية، مقربة لأقرب جزء من عشرة من المائة، هي تعديل تكلفة المعيشة (COLA).

segments.src: 4. If prices did not rise, there is no COLA. Benefits are not cut in that case.
segments.tr: 4. إذا لم ترتفع الأسعار، فلا يوجد تعديل تكلفة المعيشة (COLA). لا يتم تخفيض المزايا في هذه الحالة.

segments.src: The new rate is announced in October and applies to benefits starting with the January payment.
segments.tr: يتم الإعلان عن المعدل الجديد في أكتوبر وينطبق على المزايا بدءاً من دفعة يناير.

segments.src: For people who receive Social Security, the increase shows up in the payment received in January.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للأشخاص الذين يتلقون الضمان الاجتماعي، تظهر الزيادة في الدفعة المستلمة في يناير.

segments.src: For Supplemental Security Income (SSI), the higher payment arrives at the start of January.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لدخل الأمن التكميلي (SSI)، تصل الدفعة الأعلى في بداية شهر يناير.

segments.src: ## Why the Raise Can Feel Smaller
segments.tr: ## لماذا قد تبدو الزيادة أصغر

segments.src: ### 1. Medicare Part B premiums are usually deducted first
segments.tr: ### 1. عادة ما يتم خصم أقساط الجزء ب من الرعاية الصحية (Medicare Part B) أولاً

segments.src: Most retirees on Medicare pay the Part B premium, and for those who collect Social Security it is typically taken straight out of the monthly benefit.
segments.tr: يدفع معظم المتقاعدين على برنامج الرعاية الصحية قسط الجزء (Part B)، وبالنسبة لأولئك الذين يتقاضون الضمان الاجتماعي، يتم خصمه عادةً مباشرة من الاستحقاق الشهري.

segments.src: When the premium rises, the net increase shrinks.
segments.tr: عندما يرتفع القسط، ينكمش صافي الزيادة.

segments.src: Part B premiums have climbed in recent years.
segments.tr: ارتفعت أقساط الجزء (Part B) في السنوات الأخيرة.

segments.src: For reference, the standard monthly premium was $185.00 in 2025 and $202.90 in 2026.
segments.tr: للرجوع إليها، كان القسط الشهري القياسي $185.00 في عام 2025 و $202.90 في عام 2026.

segments.src: The 2027 amount is set by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), so confirm the current figure on Medicare.gov.
segments.tr: تم تحديد مبلغ عام 2027 بواسطة مراكز خدمات الرعاية الصحية والخدمات الطبية (CMS)، لذا تأكد من الرقم الحالي على موقع Medicare.gov.

segments.src: A simple example with made-up numbers: a retiree receives $2,000 a month before deductions.
segments.tr: مثال بسيط بأرقام افتراضية: يحصل المتقاعد على $2,000 شهرياً قبل الخصومات.

segments.src: A 3% COLA adds $60.
segments.tr: يضيف تعديل تكلفة المعيشة (COLA) بنسبة 3% مبلغ $60.

segments.src: If the Part B premium rises by $15 the same month, the real gain is $45, not $60.
segments.tr: إذا ارتفع قسط الجزء (Part B) بمقدار $15 في نفس الشهر، يكون المكسب الحقيقي هو $45، وليس $60.

segments.src: ### 2. The "hold harmless" rule has limits
segments.tr: ### 2. قاعدة "عدم الضرر" لها حدود

segments.src: A federal protection called the hold harmless provision generally prevents a beneficiary's Social Security check from falling because of a Part B premium increase.
segments.tr: الحماية الفيدرالية المسمى بشرط عدم الضرر تمنع بشكل عام شيك الضمان الاجتماعي للمستفيد من الانخفاض بسبب زيادة قسط الجزء (Part B).

segments.src: But it does not apply to everyone.
segments.tr: لكنه لا ينطبق على الجميع.

segments.src: People who are newly enrolled in Medicare, those who pay higher income-related premiums, and those who do not have the premium deducted from their benefit are generally not covered.
segments.tr: الأشخاص الذين تم تسجيلهم حديثاً في الرعاية الصحية، أولئك الذين يدفعون أقساطاً أعلى مرتبطة بالدخل، وأولئك الذين ليس لديهم قسط مستقطع منbenefit الخاص بهم لا يتم تغطيتهم عموماً.

segments.src: It also does not guarantee the COLA will be fully intact, only that the net check will not shrink.
segments.tr: كما أنه لا يضمن بقاء (COLA) سليماً تماماً، بل يضمن فقط عدم تقلص الشيك الصافي.

segments.src: ### 3. Higher-income retirees may pay an income-related surcharge
segments.tr: ### 3. قد يدفع المتقاعدون ذوو الدخل الأعلى رسوماً إضافية مرتبطة بالدخل

segments.src: Some beneficiaries pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA) on top of the standard Part B and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: يدفع بعض المستفيدين مبلغ تعديل شهري مرتبط بالدخل (IRMAA) بالإضافة إلى أقساط الجزء (Part B) والجزء (Part D) القياسية.

segments.src: It is based on tax returns from two years earlier.
segments.tr: وهو يعتمد على الإقرارات الضريبية من العامين السابقين.

segments.src: A raise in benefits, plus other income, can occasionally push someone into a higher bracket.
segments.tr: الزيادة في المزايا، بالإضافة إلى الدخل الآخر، يمكن أن تدفع شخص ما أحياناً إلى شريحة أعلى.

segments.src: ### 4. Your personal costs may not match CPI-W
segments.tr: ### 4. قد لا تتطابق تكاليفك الشخصية مع مؤشر (CPI-W)

segments.src: CPI-W measures a general basket of goods for working households.
segments.tr: يقيس (CPI-W) سلة عامة من السلع للأسر العاملة.

segments.src: Retirees often spend a larger share of income on health care, housing, and utilities.
segments.tr: غالبًا ما ينفق المتقاعدون حصة أكبر من الدخل على الرعاية الصحية والإسكان والمرافق.

segments.src: If those categories rise faster than the overall index, a COLA that matches the headline inflation rate can still feel inadequate.
segments.tr: إذا ارتفعت هذه الفئات بشكل أسرع من المؤشر العام، فقد يظل تعديل تكلفة المعيشة (COLA) الذي يطابق معدل التضخم في العنوان الرئيسي يبدو غير كافٍ.

segments.src: Researchers and advocacy groups have long debated whether an index weighted toward older consumers would be more accurate, but the law currently uses CPI-W.
segments.tr: ناقش الباحثون ومجموعات المناصرة لفترة طويلة ما إذا كان المؤشر المرجح تجاه المستهلكين الأكبر سناً سيكون أكثر دقة، لكن القانون يستخدم حالياً (CPI-W).

segments.src: ### 5. Taxes can take a bite
segments.tr: ### 5. يمكن أن تؤثر الضرائب بشكل كبير

segments.src: Depending on your "combined income" (adjusted gross income, nontaxable interest, and half of your Social Security benefits), up to 85% of your benefit may be subject to federal income tax.
segments.tr: اعتماداً على "الدخل المجمع" الخاص بك (إجمالي الدخل المعدل، الفوائد غير الخاضعة للضريبة، ونصف مزايا الضمان الاجتماعي الخاصة بك)، قد يخضع ما يصل إلى 85% من مزاياك لضريبة الدخل الفيدرالية.

segments.src: The income thresholds are not indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: عتبات الدخل ليست مفهرسة للتضخم.

segments.src: As benefits rise with COLAs over time, more retirees can find a portion of their benefit taxed.
segments.tr: مع زيادة المزايا مع (COLA) بمرور الوقت، يمكن لمزيد من المتقاعدين العثور على جزء منbenefit الخاص بهم خاضع للضريبة.

segments.src: Some states also tax benefits, though most do not.
segments.tr: تفرض بعض الولايات ضرائب على المزايا أيضاً، على الرغم من أن معظمها لا يفعل ذلك.

segments.src: ### 6. Other deductions and premiums
segments.tr: ### 6. خصومات وأقساط أخرى

segments.src: Medicare Part D drug plan premiums, Medicare Advantage plan premiums, supplemental (Medigap) policy premiums, and deductibles often change at the start of the year.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تتغير أقساط خطة أدوية الجزء (Part D) من Medicare، وأقساط خطة Medicare Advantage، وأقساط بوليصة التأمين التكميلي (Medigap)، والمخصومات في بداية العام.

segments.src: Not all of these come out of the Social Security check, but they affect your total budget.
segments.tr: لا يأتي كل هذا من شيك الضمان الاجتماعي، لكنها تؤثر على ميزانيتك الإجمالية.

segments.src: ## A January Checklist
segments.tr: ## قائمة التحقق لشهر يناير

segments.src: Use the weeks before the new year to review the details:
segments.tr: استخدم الأسابيع التي تسبق العام الجديد لمراجعة التفاصيل:

segments.src: - **Find your official notice.** The SSA sends a COLA notice that shows your new gross benefit, the Part B premium withheld, and your net payment. Many people can view it in their online *my Social Security* account.
segments.tr: - **ابحث عن إشعارك الرسمي.** ترسل إدارة الضمان الاجتماعي (SSA) إشعار (COLA) يوضحbenefit الإجمالي الجديد الخاص بك، وقسط الجزء (Part B) المقتطع، وصافي الدفع الخاص بك. يمكن للعديد من الأشخاص عرضه في حساب *my Social* Security عبر الإنترنت.

segments.src: - **Compare gross and net.** Write down your current deposit and your expected deposit after the Part B premium and any other withholding. This is the number that matters for your monthly budget.
segments.tr: - **قارن بين الإجمالي والصافي.** اكتب وديعتك الحالية ووديعتك المتوقعة بعد قسط الجزء (Part B) وأي اقتطاعات أخرى. هذا هو الرقم المهم لميزانيتك الشهرية.

segments.src: - **Review your Medicare plan during open enrollment.** The annual Medicare open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7. Compare drug coverage and Medicare Advantage plans, since premiums, copays, and covered drugs can change.
segments.tr: - **راجع خطة الرعاية الصحية (Medicare) أثناء فترة التسجيل المفتوحة.** فترة التسجيل المفتوحة السنوية لـ Medicare تمتد من 15 أكتوبر إلى 7 ديسمبر. قارن تغطية الأدوية وخطط (Medicare Advantage)، نظراً لأن الأقساط والمصاريف المشتركة والأدوية المشمولة يمكن أن تتغير.

segments.src: - **Check for IRMAA letters.** If your income dropped because of retirement or another life event, you may be able to request a new determination from the SSA.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من خطابات (IRMAA).** إذا انخفض دخلك بسبب التقاعد أو حدث حياتي آخر، فقد تتمكن من طلب تحديد جديد من (SSA).

segments.src: - **Adjust tax withholding.** If a larger share of your benefit becomes taxable, consider whether to update withholding using Form W-4V or make estimated payments, so there is no surprise at tax time.
