fr.title: Le bilan COLA 2027 : pourquoi une augmentation de la Sécurité sociale semble souvent plus faible qu'elle n'y paraît

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for a single percentage: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA.
segments.tr: Chaque automne, des millions de bénéficiaires de la Sécurité sociale attendent un seul pourcentage : l'ajustement du coût de la vie, ou COLA.

segments.src: It is meant to help benefits keep pace with rising prices.
segments.tr: Il est censé aider les prestations à suivre le rythme de la hausse des prix.

segments.src: Yet many retirees open their first statement of the new year and feel the increase has already vanished.
segments.tr: Pourtant, de nombreux retraités ouvrent leur premier relevé de la nouvelle année et ont l'impression que l'augmentation a déjà disparu.

segments.src: This guide explains how the COLA is calculated, why the number on the headline is not the same as the change in your bank deposit, and what to review before January.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique comment le COLA est calculé, pourquoi le chiffre affiché ne correspond pas au changement sur votre compte bancaire, et ce qu'il faut vérifier avant janvier.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not personal financial, tax, or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Cet article fournit des informations générales et ne constitue pas un conseil financier, fiscal ou juridique personnel.

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Medicare for figures that apply to you.*
segments.tr: Consultez l'Administration de la Sécurité sociale (SSA) et Medicare pour connaître les chiffres qui vous concernent.*

segments.src: ## How the COLA Is Calculated
segments.tr: ## Comment le COLA est calculé

segments.src: The COLA is tied to inflation, but not the version most people see in the news.
segments.tr: Le COLA est lié à l'inflation, mais pas à la version que la plupart des gens voient aux informations.

segments.src: By law, it is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, known as CPI-W, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
segments.tr: Par la loi, il est basé sur l'indice des prix à la consommation pour les salariés urbains et les employés de bureau, connu sous le nom de CPI-W, publié par le Bureau of Labor Statistics.

segments.src: The basic steps are:
segments.tr: Les étapes de base sont :

segments.src: 1. The SSA averages the CPI-W for July, August, and September of the current year.
segments.tr: 1. La SSA calcule la moyenne du CPI-W pour juillet, août et septembre de l'année en cours.

segments.src: 2. It compares that average with the same three-month average from the previous year.
segments.tr: 2. Elle compare cette moyenne avec la même moyenne sur trois mois de l'année précédente.

segments.src: 3. The percentage increase, rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent, becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. Le pourcentage d'augmentation, arrondi au dixième de pourcent le plus proche, devient le COLA.

segments.src: 4. If prices did not rise, there is no COLA. Benefits are not cut in that case.
segments.tr: 4. Si les prix n'ont pas augmenté, il n'y a pas de COLA. Les prestations ne sont pas réduites dans ce cas.

segments.src: The new rate is announced in October and applies to benefits starting with the January payment.
segments.tr: Le nouveau taux est annoncé en octobre et s'applique aux prestations à compter du versement de janvier.

segments.src: For people who receive Social Security, the increase shows up in the payment received in January.
segments.tr: Pour les personnes qui perçoivent la Sécurité sociale, l'augmentation apparaît dans le paiement reçu en janvier.

segments.src: For Supplemental Security Income (SSI), the higher payment arrives at the start of January.
segments.tr: Pour le revenu complémentaire de sécurité (SSI), le paiement majoré arrive au début du mois de janvier.

segments.src: ## Why the Raise Can Feel Smaller
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'augmentation peut sembler plus faible

segments.src: ### 1. Medicare Part B premiums are usually deducted first
segments.tr: ### 1. Les primes de la partie B de Medicare sont généralement déduites en premier

segments.src: Most retirees on Medicare pay the Part B premium, and for those who collect Social Security it is typically taken straight out of the monthly benefit.
segments.tr: La plupart des retraités inscrits à Medicare paient la prime de la partie B, et pour ceux qui perçoivent la Sécurité sociale, elle est généralement prélevée directement sur la prestation mensuelle.

segments.src: When the premium rises, the net increase shrinks.
segments.tr: Lorsque la prime augmente, l'augmentation nette diminue.

segments.src: Part B premiums have climbed in recent years.
segments.tr: Les primes de la partie B ont grimpé ces dernières années.

segments.src: For reference, the standard monthly premium was $185.00 in 2025 and $202.90 in 2026.
segments.tr: À titre de référence, la prime mensuelle standard était de $185.00 en 2025 et de $202.90 en 2026.

segments.src: The 2027 amount is set by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), so confirm the current figure on Medicare.gov.
segments.tr: Le montant pour 2027 est fixé par les Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), veuillez donc confirmer le chiffre actuel sur Medicare.gov.

segments.src: A simple example with made-up numbers: a retiree receives $2,000 a month before deductions.
segments.tr: Un exemple simple avec des chiffres fictifs : un retraité reçoit $2,000 par mois avant déductions.

segments.src: A 3% COLA adds $60.
segments.tr: Un COLA de 3 % ajoute $60.

segments.src: If the Part B premium rises by $15 the same month, the real gain is $45, not $60.
segments.tr: Si la prime de la partie B augmente de $15 le même mois, le gain réel est de $45, et non de $60.

segments.src: ### 2. The "hold harmless" rule has limits
segments.tr: ### 2. La règle de la "non-aggravation" (hold harmless) a des limites

segments.src: A federal protection called the hold harmless provision generally prevents a beneficiary's Social Security check from falling because of a Part B premium increase.
segments.tr: Une protection fédérale appelée disposition de non-aggravation empêche généralement le chèque de Sécurité sociale d'un bénéficiaire de baisser en raison d'une augmentation de la prime de la partie B.

segments.src: But it does not apply to everyone.
segments.tr: Mais elle ne s'applique pas à tout le monde.

segments.src: People who are newly enrolled in Medicare, those who pay higher income-related premiums, and those who do not have the premium deducted from their benefit are generally not covered.
segments.tr: Les personnes nouvellement inscrites à Medicare, celles qui paient des primes plus élevées liées au revenu et celles dont la prime n'est pas déduite de leur prestation ne sont généralement pas couvertes.

segments.src: It also does not guarantee the COLA will be fully intact, only that the net check will not shrink.
segments.tr: Cela ne garantit pas non plus que le COLA restera entièrement intact, mais seulement que le chèque net ne diminuera pas.

segments.src: ### 3. Higher-income retirees may pay an income-related surcharge
segments.tr: ### 3. Les retraités aux revenus plus élevés peuvent payer une surtaxe liée au revenu

segments.src: Some beneficiaries pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA) on top of the standard Part B and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: Certains bénéficiaires paient un montant d'ajustement mensuel lié au revenu (IRMAA) en plus des primes standard des parties B et D.

segments.src: It is based on tax returns from two years earlier.
segments.tr: Il est basé sur les déclarations de revenus d'il y a deux ans.

segments.src: A raise in benefits, plus other income, can occasionally push someone into a higher bracket.
segments.tr: Une augmentation des prestations, combinée à d'autres revenus, peut parfois faire basculer quelqu'un dans une tranche supérieure.

segments.src: ### 4. Your personal costs may not match CPI-W
segments.tr: ### 4. Vos dépenses personnelles peuvent ne pas correspondre au CPI-W

segments.src: CPI-W measures a general basket of goods for working households.
segments.tr: Le CPI-W mesure un panier général de biens pour les ménages de travailleurs.

segments.src: Retirees often spend a larger share of income on health care, housing, and utilities.
segments.tr: Les retraités consacrent souvent une plus grande part de leurs revenus aux soins de santé, au logement et aux services publics.

segments.src: If those categories rise faster than the overall index, a COLA that matches the headline inflation rate can still feel inadequate.
segments.tr: Si ces catégories augmentent plus rapidement que l'indice global, un COLA qui correspond au taux d'inflation global peut toujours sembler insuffisant.

segments.src: Researchers and advocacy groups have long debated whether an index weighted toward older consumers would be more accurate, but the law currently uses CPI-W.
segments.tr: Les chercheurs et les groupes de défense débattent depuis longtemps pour savoir si un indice pondéré en fonction des consommateurs plus âgés serait plus précis, mais la loi utilise actuellement le CPI-W.

segments.src: ### 5. Taxes can take a bite
segments.tr: ### 5. Les impôts peuvent mordre sur vos gains

segments.src: Depending on your "combined income" (adjusted gross income, nontaxable interest, and half of your Social Security benefits), up to 85% of your benefit may be subject to federal income tax.
segments.tr: Selon votre "revenu combiné" (revenu brut ajusté, intérêts non imposables et moitié de vos prestations de Sécurité sociale), jusqu'à 85 % de votre prestation peut être assujettie à l'impôt fédéral sur le revenu.

segments.src: The income thresholds are not indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: Les seuils de revenus ne sont pas indexés sur l'inflation.

segments.src: As benefits rise with COLAs over time, more retirees can find a portion of their benefit taxed.
segments.tr: Au fur et à mesure que les prestations augmentent avec le COLA au fil du temps, un plus grand nombre de retraités peuvent voir une partie de leurs prestations taxée.

segments.src: Some states also tax benefits, though most do not.
segments.tr: Certains États taxent également les prestations, bien que la plupart ne le fassent pas.

segments.src: ### 6. Other deductions and premiums
segments.tr: ### 6. Autres déductions et primes

segments.src: Medicare Part D drug plan premiums, Medicare Advantage plan premiums, supplemental (Medigap) policy premiums, and deductibles often change at the start of the year.
segments.tr: Les primes du plan de médicaments Medicare Partie D, les primes du plan Medicare Advantage, les primes des polices complémentaires (Medigap) et les franchises changent souvent au début de l'année.

segments.src: Not all of these come out of the Social Security check, but they affect your total budget.
segments.tr: Tous ces éléments ne proviennent pas du chèque de la Sécurité sociale, mais ils affectent votre budget total.

segments.src: ## A January Checklist
segments.tr: ## Une liste de contrôle pour janvier

segments.src: Use the weeks before the new year to review the details:
segments.tr: Profitez des semaines précédant la nouvelle année pour examiner les détails :

segments.src: - **Find your official notice.** The SSA sends a COLA notice that shows your new gross benefit, the Part B premium withheld, and your net payment. Many people can view it in their online *my Social Security* account.
segments.tr: - **Trouvez votre avis officiel.** La SSA envoie un avis COLA qui indique votre nouvelle prestation brute, la prime de la partie B retenue et votre paiement net. De nombreuses personnes peuvent le consulter dans leur compte en ligne *my Social Security*.

segments.src: - **Compare gross and net.** Write down your current deposit and your expected deposit after the Part B premium and any other withholding. This is the number that matters for your monthly budget.
segments.tr: - **Comparez le brut et le net.** Notez votre dépôt actuel et votre dépôt prévu après déduction de la prime de la partie B et de toute autre retenue. C'est le chiffre qui compte pour votre budget mensuel.

segments.src: - **Review your Medicare plan during open enrollment.** The annual Medicare open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7. Compare drug coverage and Medicare Advantage plans, since premiums, copays, and covered drugs can change.
segments.tr: - **Examinez votre plan Medicare pendant la période d'inscription ouverte.** La période d'inscription ouverte annuelle à Medicare court du 15 octobre au 7 décembre. Comparez la couverture des médicaments et les plans Medicare Advantage, car les primes, les co-paiements et les médicaments couverts peuvent changer.

segments.src: - **Check for IRMAA letters.** If your income dropped because of retirement or another life event, you may be able to request a new determination from the SSA.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez les lettres IRMAA.** Si vos revenus ont baissé en raison de la retraite ou d'un autre événement de la vie, vous pourrez peut-être demander une nouvelle décision de la part de la SSA.

segments.src: - **Adjust tax withholding.** If a larger share of your benefit becomes taxable, consider whether to update withholding using Form W-4V or make estimated payments, so there is no surprise at tax time.
segments.tr: - **Ajustez les retenues fiscales.** Si une plus grande partie de vos prestations devient imposable, étudiez la possibilité de mettre à jour vos retenues à l'aide du formulaire W-4V ou d'effectuer des paiements estimés, afin d'éviter les surprises au moment des impôts.

segments.src: - **Look at your spending categories.** Track housing, health care, food, and utilities for a few months to see which costs are actually rising for you.
segments.tr: - **Examinez vos catégories de dépenses.** Suivez le logement, les soins de santé, l'alimentation et les services publics pendant quelques mois pour voir quels coûts augmentent réellement pour vous.

segments.src: - **Ask about assistance programs.** Medicare Savings Programs, Extra Help for prescription costs, and state or local assistance may help people with limited income and resources. Your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) offers free counseling.
segments.tr: - **Renseignez-vous sur les programmes d'assistance.** Les programmes d'épargne Medicare, l'aide supplémentaire pour les frais de prescription et l'assistance étatique ou locale peuvent aider les personnes disposant de revenus et de ressources limités. Votre State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) propose des conseils gratuits.

segments.src: - **Beware of scams.** The SSA does not call to demand payment or threaten to suspend your benefit over a COLA. Use official channels such as ssa.gov and be wary of unsolicited calls, texts, or emails.
segments.tr: - **Méfiez-vous des escroqueries.** La SSA n'appelle pas pour exiger un paiement ou menacer de suspendre vos prestations à cause du COLA. Utilisez les canaux officiels tels que ssa.gov et méfiez-vous des appels, SMS ou e-mails non sollicités.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The COLA is an important protection against inflation, and it adjusts every year without an application.
segments.tr: Le COLA est une protection importante contre l'inflation, et il s'ajuste chaque année sans qu'il soit nécessaire d'en faire la demande.

segments.src: But the headline percentage is a starting point, not the final answer.
segments.tr: Mais le pourcentage affiché n'est qu'un point de départ, pas le résultat final.

segments.src: What lands in your account depends on Medicare premiums, taxes, and how your own expenses compare with the national index.
segments.tr: Ce qui arrive sur votre compte dépend des primes de Medicare, des impôts et de la façon dont vos propres dépenses se comparent à l'indice national.

segments.src: Review your official notice, compare your net deposit with your real costs, and use the fall enrollment season to look for savings.
segments.tr: Examinez votre avis officiel, comparez votre dépôt net avec vos coûts réels et profitez de la saison d'inscription d'automne pour chercher des économies.

segments.src: A few hours of checking now can make the January change far less of a surprise.
segments.tr: Quelques heures de vérification dès maintenant peuvent rendre le changement de janvier beaucoup moins surprenant.

segments.src: *Figures and rules can change.
segments.tr: *Les chiffres et les règles peuvent changer.

segments.src: Confirm the current COLA, Medicare premiums, and thresholds with the Social Security Administration (ssa.gov) and Medicare (medicare.gov).*
segments.tr: Confirmez le COLA actuel, les primes de Medicare et les seuils auprès de la Social Security Administration (ssa.gov) et de Medicare (medicare.gov).*

segments.src: A federal protection called the hold harmless provision generally prevents a beneficiary's Social Security check from falling because of a Part B premium increase.
segments.tr: Uma proteção federal chamada provisão de isenção de danos geralmente impede que o cheque da Previdência Social de um beneficiário caia devido a um aumento no prêmio da Parte B.

segments.src: But it does not apply to everyone.
segments.tr: Mas ela não se aplica a todos.

segments.src: People who are newly enrolled in Medicare, those who pay higher income-related premiums, and those who do not have the premium deducted from their benefit are generally not covered.
segments.tr: Pessoas recém-inscritas no Medicare, aquelas que pagam prêmios mais altos relacionados à renda e aquelas que não têm o prêmio deduzido de seu benefício geralmente não estão cobertas.

segments.src: It also does not guarantee the COLA will be fully intact, only that the net check will not shrink.
segments.tr: Ela também não garante que o COLA permanecerá totalmente intacto, apenas que o cheque líquido não encolherá.

segments.src: ### 3. Higher-income retirees may pay an income-related surcharge
segments.tr: ### 3. Aposentados de maior renda podem pagar um acréscimo relacionado à renda

segments.src: Some beneficiaries pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA) on top of the standard Part B and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: Alguns beneficiários pagam um Valor de Ajuste Mensal Relacionado à Renda (IRMAA) além dos prêmios padrão das Partes B e D.

segments.src: It is based on tax returns from two years earlier.
segments.tr: Ele se baseia nas declarações de imposto de renda de dois anos anteriores.

segments.src: A raise in benefits, plus other income, can occasionally push someone into a higher bracket.
segments.tr: Um aumento nos benefícios, somado a outras fontes de renda, pode ocasionalmente empurrar alguém para uma faixa superior.

segments.src: ### 4. Your personal costs may not match CPI-W
segments.tr: ### 4. Seus custos pessoais podem não corresponder ao CPI-W

segments.src: CPI-W measures a general basket of goods for working households.
segments.tr: O CPI-W mede uma cesta geral de bens para famílias trabalhadoras.

segments.src: Retirees often spend a larger share of income on health care, housing, and utilities.
segments.tr: Os aposentados costumam gastar uma parcela maior da renda com saúde, moradia e serviços públicos.

segments.src: If those categories rise faster than the overall index, a COLA that matches the headline inflation rate can still feel inadequate.
segments.tr: Se essas categorias subirem mais rápido do que o índice geral, um COLA que corresponda à taxa de inflação principal ainda pode parecer inadequado.

segments.src: Researchers and advocacy groups have long debated whether an index weighted toward older consumers would be more accurate, but the law currently uses CPI-W.
segments.tr: Pesquisadores e grupos de defesa há muito debatem se um índice ponderado para consumidores mais velhos seria mais preciso, mas a lei atualmente usa o CPI-W.

segments.src: ### 5. Taxes can take a bite
segments.tr: ### 5. Os impostos podem morder uma parte

segments.src: Depending on your "combined income" (adjusted gross income, nontaxable interest, and half of your Social Security benefits), up to 85% of your benefit may be subject to federal income tax.
segments.tr: Dependendo da sua "renda combinada" (renda bruta ajustada, juros isentos de impostos e metade dos seus benefícios da Previdência Social), até 85% do seu benefício pode estar sujeito ao imposto de renda federal.

segments.src: The income thresholds are not indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: Os limites de renda não são indexados à inflação.

segments.src: As benefits rise with COLAs over time, more retirees can find a portion of their benefit taxed.
segments.tr: À medida que os benefícios aumentam com os COLAs ao longo do tempo, mais aposentados podem descobrir que uma parcela de seu benefício é taxada.

segments.src: Some states also tax benefits, though most do not.
segments.tr: Alguns estados também taxam os benefícios, embora a maioria não o faça.

segments.src: ### 6. Other deductions and premiums
segments.tr: ### 6. Outras deduções e prêmios

segments.src: Medicare Part D drug plan premiums, Medicare Advantage plan premiums, supplemental (Medigap) policy premiums, and deductibles often change at the start of the year.
segments.tr: Os prêmios do plano de medicamentos do Medicare Parte D, os prêmios do plano Medicare Advantage, os prêmios de políticas suplementares (Medigap) e as franquias frequentemente mudam no início do ano.

segments.src: Not all of these come out of the Social Security check, but they affect your total budget.
segments.tr: Nem todos vêm do cheque da Previdência Social, mas eles afetam seu orçamento total.

segments.src: ## A January Checklist
segments.tr: ## Uma Lista de Verificação para Janeiro

segments.src: Use the weeks before the new year to review the details:
segments.tr: Use as semanas antes do ano novo para revisar os detalhes:

segments.src: - **Find your official notice.** The SSA sends a COLA notice that shows your new gross benefit, the Part B premium withheld, and your net payment. Many people can view it in their online *my Social Security* account.
segments.tr: - **Encontre seu aviso oficial.** A SSA envia um aviso do COLA que mostra seu novo benefício bruto, o prêmio da Parte B retido e seu pagamento líquido. Muitas pessoas podem visualizá-lo em sua conta online *my Social Security*.

segments.src: - **Compare gross and net.** Write down your current deposit and your expected deposit after the Part B premium and any other withholding. This is the number that matters for your monthly budget.
segments.tr: - **Compare o bruto e o líquido.** Anote seu depósito atual e seu depósito esperado após o prêmio da Parte B e qualquer outra retenção. Este é o número que importa para o seu orçamento mensal.

segments.src: - **Review your Medicare plan during open enrollment.** The annual Medicare open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7. Compare drug coverage and Medicare Advantage plans, since premiums, copays, and covered drugs can change.
segments.tr: - **Revise seu plano do Medicare durante a inscrição aberta.** O período anual de inscrição aberta do Medicare vai de 15 de outubro a 7 de dezembro. Compare a cobertura de medicamentos e os planos Medicare Advantage, pois prêmios, copagtos e medicamentos cobertos podem mudar.

segments.src: - **Check for IRMAA letters.** If your income dropped because of retirement or another life event, you may be able to request a new determination from the SSA.
segments.tr: - **Verifique cartas sobre o IRMAA.** Se sua renda caiu devido à aposentadoria ou outro evento de vida, você pode solicitar uma nova determinação da SSA.

segments.src: - **Adjust tax withholding.** If a larger share of your benefit becomes taxable, consider whether to update withholding using Form W-4V or make estimated payments, so there is no surprise at tax time.
segments.tr: - **Ajuste a retenção de impostos.** Se uma parcela maior do seu benefício se tornar tributável, considere atualizar a retenção usando o Formulário W-4V ou fazer pagamentos estimados, para não ter surpresas na época do imposto de renda.

segments.src: - **Look at your spending categories.** Track housing, health care, food, and utilities for a few months to see which costs are actually rising for you.
segments.tr: - **Analise suas categorias de gastos.** Acompanhe moradia, saúde, alimentação e serviços públicos por alguns meses para ver quais custos estão realmente subindo para você.

segments.src: - **Ask about assistance programs.** Medicare Savings Programs, Extra Help for prescription costs, and state or local assistance may help people with limited income and resources. Your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) offers free counseling.
segments.tr: - **Pergunte sobre programas de assistência.** Programas de Poupança do Medicare, Ajuda Extra para custos de medicamentos e assistência estadual ou local podem ajudar pessoas com renda e recursos limitados. Seu Programa Estadual de Assistência ao Seguro Saúde (SHIP) oferece aconselhamento gratuito.

segments.src: - **Beware of scams.** The SSA does not call to demand payment or threaten to suspend your benefit over a COLA. Use official channels such as ssa.gov and be wary of unsolicited calls, texts, or emails.
segments.tr: - **Cuidado com golpes.** A SSA não liga para exigir pagamento nem ameaça suspender seu benefício por causa de um COLA. Use canais oficiais como ssa.gov e desconfie de ligações, mensagens de texto ou e-mails não solicitados.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## O Conclusão

segments.src: The COLA is an important protection against inflation, and it adjusts every year without an application.
segments.tr: O COLA é uma proteção importante contra a inflação e é ajustado todos os anos sem necessidade de solicitação.

segments.src: But the headline percentage is a starting point, not the final answer.
segments.tr: Mas a porcentagem da manchete é um ponto de partida, não a resposta final.

segments.src: What lands in your account depends on Medicare premiums, taxes, and how your own expenses compare with the national index.
segments.tr: O que cai na sua conta depende dos prêmios do Medicare, dos impostos e de como suas próprias despesas se comparam ao índice nacional.

segments.src: Review your official notice, compare your net deposit with your real costs, and use the fall enrollment season to look for savings.
segments.tr: Revise seu aviso oficial, compare seu depósito líquido com seus custos reais e use a temporada de inscrição de outono para buscar economia.

segments.src: A few hours of checking now can make the January change far less of a surprise.
segments.tr: Algumas horas de verificação agora podem tornar a mudança de janeiro muito menos surpreendente.

segments.src: *Figures and rules can change.
segments.tr: *Valores e regras podem mudar.

segments.src: Confirm the current COLA, Medicare premiums, and thresholds with the Social Security Administration (ssa.gov) and Medicare (medicare.gov).*
segments.tr: Confirme o COLA atual, os prêmios do Medicare e os limites com a Administração da Previdência Social (ssa.gov) e o Medicare (medicare.gov).*

in.title: Pemeriksaan COLA 2027: Mengapa Kenaikan Jaminan Sosial Sering Terasa Lebih Kecil dari Kelihatannya

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for a single percentage: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA.
segments.tr: Setiap musim gugur, jutaan penerima Jaminan Sosial menantikan satu persentase tunggal: penyesuaian biaya hidup, atau COLA.

segments.src: It is meant to help benefits keep pace with rising prices.
segments.tr: Ini dimaksudkan untuk membantu manfaat mengimbangi kenaikan harga.

segments.src: Yet many retirees open their first statement of the new year and feel the increase has already vanished.
segments.tr: Namun, banyak pensiunan yang membuka pernyataan pertama mereka di tahun baru dan merasa bahwa kenaikan tersebut telah lenyap.

segments.src: This guide explains how the COLA is calculated, why the number on the headline is not the same as the change in your bank deposit, and what to review before January.
segments.tr: Panduan ini menjelaskan bagaimana COLA dihitung, mengapa angka pada tajuk utama tidak sama dengan perubahan setoran bank Anda, dan apa yang harus ditinjau sebelum Januari.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not personal financial, tax, or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan, pajak, atau hukum pribadi.

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Medicare for figures that apply to you.*
segments.tr: Periksa Administrasi Jaminan Sosial (SSA) dan Medicare untuk angka yang berlaku bagi Anda.*

segments.src: ## How the COLA Is Calculated
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana COLA Dihitung

segments.src: The COLA is tied to inflation, but not the version most people see in the news.
segments.tr: COLA terikat pada inflasi, tetapi bukan versi yang dilihat kebanyakan orang di berita.

segments.src: By law, it is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, known as CPI-W, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
segments.tr: Berdasarkan undang-undang, COLA didasarkan pada Indeks Harga Konsumen untuk Pekerja Upah Perkotaan dan Pekerja Klerikal, yang dikenal sebagai CPI-W, yang diterbitkan oleh Biro Statistik Tenaga Kerja.

segments.src: The basic steps are:
segments.tr: Langkah-langkah dasarnya adalah:

segments.src: 1. The SSA averages the CPI-W for July, August, and September of the current year.
segments.tr: 1. SSA menghitung rata-rata CPI-W untuk bulan Juli, Agustus, dan September tahun berjalan.

segments.src: 2. It compares that average with the same three-month average from the previous year.
segments.tr: 2. SSA membandingkan rata-rata tersebut dengan rata-rata tiga bulan yang sama dari tahun sebelumnya.

segments.src: 3. The percentage increase, rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent, becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. Persentase kenaikan, yang dibulatkan ke persepuluhan persen terdekat, menjadi COLA.

segments.src: 4. If prices did not rise, there is no COLA. Benefits are not cut in that case.
segments.tr: 4. Jika harga tidak naik, tidak ada COLA. Manfaat tidak dipotong dalam hal tersebut.

segments.src: The new rate is announced in October and applies to benefits starting with the January payment.
segments.tr: Tarif baru diumumkan pada bulan Oktober dan berlaku untuk manfaat mulai pembayaran bulan Januari.

segments.src: For people who receive Social Security, the increase shows up in the payment received in January.
segments.tr: Bagi orang yang menerima Jaminan Sosial, kenaikan tersebut muncul dalam pembayaran yang diterima pada bulan Januari.

segments.src: For Supplemental Security Income (SSI), the higher payment arrives at the start of January.
segments.tr: Untuk Jaminan Penghasilan Tambahan (SSI), pembayaran yang lebih tinggi tiba pada awal Januari.

segments.src: ## Why the Raise Can Feel Smaller
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kenaikan Terasa Lebih Kecil

segments.src: ### 1. Medicare Part B premiums are usually deducted first
segments.tr: ### 1. Premi Medicare Bagian B biasanya dipotong terlebih dahulu

segments.src: Most retirees on Medicare pay the Part B premium, and for those who collect Social Security it is typically taken straight out of the monthly benefit.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar pensiunan di Medicare membayar premi Bagian B, dan bagi mereka yang menerima Jaminan Sosial, premi tersebut biasanya diambil langsung dari manfaat bulanan.

segments.src: When the premium rises, the net increase shrinks.
segments.tr: Ketika premi naik, kenaikan bersih menyusut.

segments.src: Part B premiums have climbed in recent years.
segments.tr: Premi Bagian B telah meningkat dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: For reference, the standard monthly premium was $185.00 in 2025 and $202.90 in 2026.
segments.tr: Sebagai referensi, premi bulanan standar adalah $185.00 pada tahun 2025 dan $202.90 pada tahun 2026.

segments.src: The 2027 amount is set by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), so confirm the current figure on Medicare.gov.
segments.tr: Jumlah untuk tahun 2027 ditetapkan oleh Pusat Layanan Medicare & Medicaid (CMS), jadi konfirmasikan angka saat ini di Medicare.gov.

segments.src: A simple example with made-up numbers: a retiree receives $2,000 a month before deductions.
segments.tr: Contoh sederhana dengan angka fiktif: seorang pensiunan menerima $2,000 sebulan sebelum potongan.

segments.src: A 3% COLA adds $60.
segments.tr: COLA 3% menambahkan $60.

segments.src: If the Part B premium rises by $15 the same month, the real gain is $45, not $60.
segments.tr: Jika premi Bagian B naik sebesar $15 pada bulan yang sama, keuntungan sebenarnya adalah $45, bukan $60.

segments.src: ### 2. The "hold harmless" rule has limits
segments.tr: ### 2. Aturan "hold harmless" memiliki batasan

segments.src: A federal protection called the hold harmless provision generally prevents a beneficiary's Social Security check from falling because of a Part B premium increase.
segments.tr: Perlindungan federal yang disebut ketentuan hold harmless umumnya mencegah cek Jaminan Sosial penerima turun karena kenaikan premi Bagian B.

segments.src: But it does not apply to everyone.
segments.tr: Namun aturan ini tidak berlaku untuk semua orang.

segments.src: People who are newly enrolled in Medicare, those who pay higher income-related premiums, and those who do not have the premium deducted from their benefit are generally not covered.
segments.tr: Orang yang baru terdaftar di Medicare, mereka yang membayar premi yang lebih tinggi terkait pendapatan, dan mereka yang tidak memiliki premi yang dipotong dari manfaat mereka umumnya tidak dilindungi.

segments.src: It also does not guarantee the COLA will be fully intact, only that the net check will not shrink.
segments.tr: Aturan ini juga tidak menjamin COLA akan utuh sepenuhnya, hanya saja cek bersih tidak akan menyusut.

segments.src: ### 3. Higher-income retirees may pay an income-related surcharge
segments.tr: ### 3. Pensiunan berpenghasilan lebih tinggi mungkin membayar biaya tambahan terkait pendapatan

segments.src: Some beneficiaries pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA) on top of the standard Part B and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: Beberapa penerima membayar Jumlah Penyesuaian Bulanan Terkait Pendapatan (IRMAA) di atas premi standar Bagian B dan Bagian D.

segments.src: It is based on tax returns from two years earlier.
segments.tr: Ini didasarkan pada SPT pajak dari dua tahun sebelumnya.

segments.src: A raise in benefits, plus other income, can occasionally push someone into a higher bracket.
segments.tr: Kenaikan manfaat, ditambah pendapatan lain, kadang-kadang dapat mendorong seseorang ke golongan pajak yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: ### 4. Your personal costs may not match CPI-W
segments.tr: ### 4. Biaya pribadi Anda mungkin tidak sesuai dengan CPI-W

segments.src: CPI-W measures a general basket of goods for working households.
segments.tr: CPI-W mengukur keranjang umum barang untuk rumah tangga pekerja.

segments.src: Retirees often spend a larger share of income on health care, housing, and utilities.
segments.tr: Pensiunan sering kali menghabiskan sebagian besar pendapatan mereka untuk perawatan kesehatan, perumahan, dan utilitas.

segments.src: If those categories rise faster than the overall index, a COLA that matches the headline inflation rate can still feel inadequate.
segments.tr: Jika kategori tersebut naik lebih cepat daripada indeks keseluruhan, COLA yang cocok dengan tingkat inflasi utama masih dapat terasa tidak memadai.

segments.src: Researchers and advocacy groups have long debated whether an index weighted toward older consumers would be more accurate, but the law currently uses CPI-W.
segments.tr: Para peneliti dan kelompok advokasi telah lama memperdebatkan apakah indeks yang tertimbang ke arah konsumen yang lebih tua akan lebih akurat, tetapi undang-undang saat ini menggunakan CPI-W.

segments.src: ### 5. Taxes can take a bite
segments.tr: ### 5. Pajak dapat memotong bagian Anda

segments.src: Depending on your "combined income" (adjusted gross income, nontaxable interest, and half of your Social Security benefits), up to 85% of your benefit may be subject to federal income tax.
segments.tr: Tergantung pada "pendapatan gabungan" Anda (penghasilan kotor disesuaikan, bunga tidak kena pajak, dan separuh dari manfaat Jaminan Sosial Anda), hingga 85% dari manfaat Anda dapat dikenakan pajak penghasilan federal.

segments.src: The income thresholds are not indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: Ambang batas pendapatan tidak diindeks terhadap inflasi.

segments.src: As benefits rise with COLAs over time, more retirees can find a portion of their benefit taxed.
segments.tr: Seiring meningkatnya manfaat dengan COLA dari waktu ke waktu, lebih banyak pensiunan dapat mendapati sebagian dari manfaat mereka dikenakan pajak.

segments.src: Some states also tax benefits, though most do not.
segments.tr: Beberapa negara bagian juga mengenakan pajak atas manfaat, meskipun kebanyakan tidak.

segments.src: ### 6. Other deductions and premiums
segments.tr: ### 6. Potongan dan premi lainnya

segments.src: Medicare Part D drug plan premiums, Medicare Advantage plan premiums, supplemental (Medigap) policy premiums, and deductibles often change at the start of the year.
segments.tr: Premi rencana obat Medicare Bagian D, premi rencana Medicare Advantage, premi polis suplemen (Medigap), dan deduktibel sering kali berubah pada awal tahun.

segments.src: Not all of these come out of the Social Security check, but they affect your total budget.
segments.tr: Tidak semua ini berasal dari cek Jaminan Sosial, tetapi semuanya memengaruhi anggaran total Anda.

segments.src: ## A January Checklist
segments.tr: ## Daftar Periksa Januari

segments.src: Use the weeks before the new year to review the details:
segments.tr: Gunakan minggu-minggu sebelum tahun baru untuk meninjau detailnya:

segments.src: - **Find your official notice.** The SSA sends a COLA notice that shows your new gross benefit, the Part B premium withheld, and your net payment. Many people can view it in their online *my Social Security* account.
segments.tr: - **Temukan pemberitahuan resmi Anda.** SSA mengirimkan pemberitahuan COLA yang menunjukkan manfaat kotor baru Anda, premi Bagian B yang dipotong, dan pembayaran bersih Anda. Banyak orang dapat melihatnya di akun *my Social Security* online mereka.

segments.src: - **Compare gross and net.** Write down your current deposit and your expected deposit after the Part B premium and any other withholding. This is the number that matters for your monthly budget.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan kotor dan bersih.** Catat setoran Anda saat ini dan setoran yang Anda harapkan setelah premi Bagian B dan pemotongan lainnya. Ini adalah angka yang penting untuk anggaran bulanan Anda.

segments.src: - **Review your Medicare plan during open enrollment.** The annual Medicare open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7. Compare drug coverage and Medicare Advantage plans, since premiums, copays, and covered drugs can change.
segments.tr: - **Tinjau rencana Medicare Anda selama pendaftaran terbuka.** Periode pendaftaran terbuka Medicare tahunan berjalan dari 15 Oktober hingga 7 Desember. Bandingkan cakupan obat dan rencana Medicare Advantage, karena premi, kopay, dan obat yang dicakup dapat berubah.

segments.src: - **Check for IRMAA letters.** If your income dropped because of retirement or another life event, you may be able to request a new determination from the SSA.
segments.tr: - **Periksa surat IRMAA.** Jika pendapatan Anda turun karena pensiun atau peristiwa kehidupan lainnya, Anda mungkin dapat meminta penentuan baru dari SSA.

segments.src: - **Adjust tax withholding.** If a larger share of your benefit becomes taxable, consider whether to update withholding using Form W-4V or make estimated payments, so there is no surprise at tax time.
segments.tr: - **Sesuaikan pemotongan pajak.** Jika sebagian besar manfaat Anda menjadi kena pajak, pertimbangkan apakah akan memperbarui pemotongan menggunakan Formulir W-4V atau melakukan pembayaran estimasi, sehingga tidak ada kejutan pada waktu pajak.

segments.src: - **Look at your spending categories.** Track housing, health care, food, and utilities for a few months to see which costs are actually rising for you.
segments.tr: - **Lihat kategori pengeluaran Anda.** Lacak perumahan, perawatan kesehatan, makanan, dan utilitas selama beberapa bulan untuk melihat biaya mana yang sebenarnya meningkat untuk Anda.

segments.src: - **Ask about assistance programs.** Medicare Savings Programs, Extra Help for prescription costs, and state or local assistance may help people with limited income and resources. Your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) offers free counseling.
segments.tr: - **Tanyakan tentang program bantuan.** Program Tabungan Medicare, Bantuan Tambahan untuk biaya resep, dan bantuan negara bagian atau lokal dapat membantu orang dengan pendapatan dan sumber daya terbatas. Program Bantuan Asuransi Kesehatan Negara Bagian (SHIP) Anda menawarkan konseling gratis.

segments.src: - **Beware of scams.** The SSA does not call to demand payment or threaten to suspend your benefit over a COLA. Use official channels such as ssa.gov and be wary of unsolicited calls, texts, or emails.
segments.tr: - **Waspadai penipuan.** SSA tidak menelepon untuk meminta pembayaran atau mengancam akan menangguhkan manfaat Anda karena COLA. Gunakan saluran resmi seperti ssa.gov dan waspadai panggilan, teks, atau email yang tidak diminta.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The COLA is an important protection against inflation, and it adjusts every year without an application.
segments.tr: COLA adalah perlindungan penting terhadap inflasi, dan menyesuaikan setiap tahun tanpa aplikasi.

segments.src: But the headline percentage is a starting point, not the final answer.
segments.tr: Tetapi persentase tajuk utama adalah titik awal, bukan jawaban akhir.

segments.src: What lands in your account depends on Medicare premiums, taxes, and how your own expenses compare with the national index.
segments.tr: Apa yang masuk ke akun Anda bergantung pada premi Medicare, pajak, dan bagaimana pengeluaran Anda sendiri dibandingkan dengan indeks nasional.

segments.src: Review your official notice, compare your net deposit with your real costs, and use the fall enrollment season to look for savings.
segments.tr: Tinjau pemberitahuan resmi Anda, bandingkan setoran bersih Anda dengan biaya nyata Anda, and gunakan musim pendaftaran musim gugur untuk mencari penghematan.

segments.src: A few hours of checking now can make the January change far less of a surprise.
segments.tr: Beberapa jam pemeriksaan sekarang dapat membuat perubahan bulan Januari jauh lebih tidak mengejutkan.

segments.src: *Figures and rules can change.
segments.tr: *Angka dan aturan dapat berubah.

ja.title: 2027年COLAの確認：社会保障給付金の引き上げが実際より少なく感じられる理由

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for a single percentage: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA.
segments.tr: 毎年秋になると、何百万人もの社会保障受給者が生活費調整（COLA）という1つのパーセンテージを待ち望んでいます。

segments.src: It is meant to help benefits keep pace with rising prices.
segments.tr: これは給付金が物価上昇に追随できるようにするためのものです。

segments.src: Yet many retirees open their first statement of the new year and feel the increase has already vanished.
segments.tr: しかし、多くの退職者が新年最初の明細書を開くと、引き上げ分がすでに消えてしまっているように感じます。

segments.src: This guide explains how the COLA is calculated, why the number on the headline is not the same as the change in your bank deposit, and what to review before January.
segments.tr: このガイドでは、COLAがどのように計算されるのか、ヘッドラインの数値が銀行口座の入金変動と一致しない理由、そして1月を迎える前に確認すべき事項について説明します。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not personal financial, tax, or legal advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報であり、個人の財務、税務、または法的なアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Medicare for figures that apply to you.*
segments.tr: ご自身に適用される数値については、社会保障局（SSA）およびメディケアをご確認ください。*

segments.src: ## How the COLA Is Calculated
segments.tr: ## COLAの計算方法

segments.src: The COLA is tied to inflation, but not the version most people see in the news.
segments.tr: COLAはインフレに連動していますが、ニュースで一般的に報じられるバージョンとは異なります。

segments.src: By law, it is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, known as CPI-W, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
segments.tr: 法律により、労働統計局が発表する都市部賃金労働者・事務職員消費者物価指数（CPI-W）に基づいています。

segments.src: The basic steps are:
segments.tr: 基本的な手順は以下の通りです：

segments.src: 1. The SSA averages the CPI-W for July, August, and September of the current year.
segments.tr: 1. SSAは、当年7月、8月、9月のCPI-Wの平均を算出します。

segments.src: 2. It compares that average with the same three-month average from the previous year.
segments.tr: 2. その平均を前年の同じ3カ月の平均と比較します。

segments.src: 3. The percentage increase, rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent, becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. パーセンテージの上昇率を小数点第1位に四捨五入したものがCOLAとなります。

segments.src: 4. If prices did not rise, there is no COLA. Benefits are not cut in that case.
segments.tr: 4. 物価が上昇しなかった場合、COLAはありません。その場合でも給付金が減額されることはありません。

segments.src: The new rate is announced in October and applies to benefits starting with the January payment.
segments.tr: 新しい率は10月に発表され、1月の支払い分からの給付金に適用されます。

segments.src: For people who receive Social Security, the increase shows up in the payment received in January.
segments.tr: 社会保障を受給している人にとって、引き上げ分は1月に受け取る支払いに反映されます。

segments.src: For Supplemental Security Income (SSI), the higher payment arrives at the start of January.
segments.tr: 補足保障所得（SSI）の場合、増額された支払いは1月上旬に届きます。

segments.src: ## Why the Raise Can Feel Smaller
segments.tr: ## 引き上げ分が少なく感じられる理由

segments.src: ### 1. Medicare Part B premiums are usually deducted first
segments.tr: ### 1. メディケアパートBの保険料が通常最初に差し引かれる

segments.src: Most retirees on Medicare pay the Part B premium, and for those who collect Social Security it is typically taken straight out of the monthly benefit.
segments.tr: メディケアに加入している退職者のほとんどはパートBの保険料を支払っており、社会保障を受給している人の場合、通常は毎月の給付金から直接差し引かれます。

segments.src: When the premium rises, the net increase shrinks.
segments.tr: 保険料が上がると、実質的な増額分は縮小します。

segments.src: Part B premiums have climbed in recent years.
segments.tr: パートBの保険料は近年上昇しています。

segments.src: For reference, the standard monthly premium was $185.00 in 2025 and $202.90 in 2026.
segments.tr: 参考までに、標準的な月額保険料は2025年が$185.00、2026年が$202.90でした。

segments.src: The 2027 amount is set by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), so confirm the current figure on Medicare.gov.
segments.tr: 2027年の金額はメディケア・メディケイドサービスセンター（CMS）によって設定されるため、Medicare.govで現在の数値を確認してください。

segments.src: A simple example with made-up numbers: a retiree receives $2,000 a month before deductions.
segments.tr: 架空の数字を使った簡単な例：ある退職者が控除前で月額$2,000を受け取っているとします。

segments.src: A 3% COLA adds $60.
segments.tr: 3%のCOLAにより$60が追加されます。

segments.src: If the Part B premium rises by $15 the same month, the real gain is $45, not $60.
segments.tr: もし同じ月にパートBの保険料が$15値上がりした場合、実際の増加分は$60ではなく$45になります。

segments.src: ### 2. The "hold harmless" rule has limits
segments.tr: ### 2. 「不利益不変更」ルールには制限がある

segments.src: A federal protection called the hold harmless provision generally prevents a beneficiary's Social Security check from falling because of a Part B premium increase.
segments.tr: 不利益不変更条項と呼ばれる連邦の保護規定により、通常、パートBの保険料の値上がりが原因で受給者の社会保障小切手の金額が減額されることは防がれます。

segments.src: But it does not apply to everyone.
segments.tr: しかし、これはすべての人に適用されるわけではありません。

segments.src: People who are newly enrolled in Medicare, those who pay higher income-related premiums, and those who do not have the premium deducted from their benefit are generally not covered.
segments.tr: メディケアに新たに加入した人、所得に応じた高額な保険料を支払っている人、および給付金から保険料が差し引かれていない人は、一般的に対象外となります。

segments.src: It also does not guarantee the COLA will be fully intact, only that the net check will not shrink.
segments.tr: また、COLAが完全にそのまま維持されることを保証するものではなく、受給額の純額が目減りしないことのみを保証するものです。

segments.src: ### 3. Higher-income retirees may pay an income-related surcharge
segments.tr: ### 3. 高所得の退職者は所得に応じた追加料金を支払う場合がある

segments.src: Some beneficiaries pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA) on top of the standard Part B and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: 受給者の中には、標準的なパートBおよびパートDの保険料に加えて、所得関連月額調整額（IRMAA）を支払っている人もいます。

segments.src: It is based on tax returns from two years earlier.
segments.tr: これは2年前の納税申告書に基づいています。

segments.src: A raise in benefits, plus other income, can occasionally push someone into a higher bracket.
segments.tr: 給付金の引き上げが他の所得と合わさることで、まれにより高い税率ブラケットに押し上げられることがあります。

segments.src: ### 4. Your personal costs may not match CPI-W
segments.tr: ### 4. 個人の生活費がCPI-Wと一致しない場合がある

segments.src: CPI-W measures a general basket of goods for working households.
segments.tr: CPI-Wは、働く世帯向けの一連の一般的な商品群を測定するものです。

segments.src: Retirees often spend a larger share of income on health care, housing, and utilities.
segments.tr: 退職者は、医療費、住居費、光熱費に所得のより大きな割合を費やすことがよくあります。

segments.src: If those categories rise faster than the overall index, a COLA that matches the headline inflation rate can still feel inadequate.
segments.tr: それらのカテゴリーが全体の指数よりも速く上昇した場合、ヘッドラインのインフレ率に一致するCOLAであっても、依然として不十分に感じられることがあります。

segments.src: Researchers and advocacy groups have long debated whether an index weighted toward older consumers would be more accurate, but the law currently uses CPI-W.
segments.tr: 研究者やアドボカシー団体は、高齢の消費者に重点を置いた指数の方がより正確であるかどうかについて長年議論してきましたが、現行法ではCPI-Wが使用されています。

segments.src: ### 5. Taxes can take a bite
segments.tr: ### 5. 税金による目減り

segments.src: Depending on your "combined income" (adjusted gross income, nontaxable interest, and half of your Social Security benefits), up to 85% of your benefit may be subject to federal income tax.
segments.tr: 「総合所得」（調整後総所得、非課税利子、および社会保障給付金の半分）によっては、給付金の最大85%が連邦所得税の対象となる場合があります。

segments.src: The income thresholds are not indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: 所得の閾値はインフレに連動していません。

segments.src: As benefits rise with COLAs over time, more retirees can find a portion of their benefit taxed.
segments.tr: 時間の経過とともにCOLAにより給付金が上昇するにつれて、より多くの退職者が給付金の一部に課税されることになります。

segments.src: Some states also tax benefits, though most do not.
segments.tr: 大半の州では課税されませんが、一部の州では給付金に課税されます。

segments.src: ### 6. Other deductions and premiums
segments.tr: ### 6. その他の控除と保険料

segments.src: Medicare Part D drug plan premiums, Medicare Advantage plan premiums, supplemental (Medigap) policy premiums, and deductibles often change at the start of the year.
segments.tr: メディケアパートDの処方薬プランの保険料、メディケアアドバンテージプランの保険料、補足（メディギャップ）ポリシーの保険料、および免責金額は、年初に変更されることがよくあります。

segments.src: Not all of these come out of the Social Security check, but they affect your total budget.
segments.tr: これらすべてが社会保障の小切手から差し引かれるわけではありませんが、家計全体に影響を与えます。

segments.src: ## A January Checklist
segments.tr: ## 1月のチェックリスト

segments.src: Use the weeks before the new year to review the details:
segments.tr: 新年を迎える前の数週間を利用して、詳細を確認しましょう：

segments.src: - **Find your official notice.** The SSA sends a COLA notice that shows your new gross benefit, the Part B premium withheld, and your net payment. Many people can view it in their online *my Social Security* account.
segments.tr: - **公式通知書を見つける。** SSAは、新しい総給付金、源泉徴収されたパートBの保険料、および純受給額を示すCOLA通知書を郵送します。多くの人はオンラインの*my Social Security*アカウントで確認できます。

segments.src: - **Compare gross and net.** Write down your current deposit and your expected deposit after the Part B premium and any other withholding. This is the number that matters for your monthly budget.
segments.tr: - **総額と純額を比較する。** 現在の入金額と、パートBの保険料およびその他の源泉徴収後の予測入金額を書き留めます。これが、毎月の予算において重要な数値となります。

segments.src: - **Review your Medicare plan during open enrollment.** The annual Medicare open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7. Compare drug coverage and Medicare Advantage plans, since premiums, copays, and covered drugs can change.
segments.tr: - **オープンenrollment期間中にメディケアプランを見直す。** 年次のメディケア・オープンエンロールメント期間は10月15日から12月7日までです。保険料、自己負担額、および対象となる医薬品が変更される可能性があるため、処方薬の保障内容とメディケアアドバンテージプランを比較してください。

segments.src: - **Check for IRMAA letters.** If your income dropped because of retirement or another life event, you may be able to request a new determination from the SSA.
segments.tr: - **IRMAAの通知を確認する。** 退職やその他のライフイベントによって所得が減少した場合、SSAに再判定を申請できる場合があります。

segments.src: - **Adjust tax withholding.** If a larger share of your benefit becomes taxable, consider whether to update withholding using Form W-4V or make estimated payments, so there is no surprise at tax time.
segments.tr: - **税金の源泉徴収を調整する。** 給付金のより大きな割合が課税対象となる場合は、確定申告の時期に驚くことがないよう、フォームW-4Vを使用して源泉徴収を更新するか、予定納税を行うことを検討してください。

segments.src: - **Look at your spending categories.** Track housing, health care, food, and utilities for a few months to see which costs are actually rising for you.
segments.tr: - **支出のカテゴリーを確認する。** 住居費、医療費、食費、光熱費を数ヶ月間追跡し、どのコストが実際に自分にとって上昇しているかを確認します。

segments.src: - **Ask about assistance programs.** Medicare Savings Programs, Extra Help for prescription costs, and state or local assistance may help people with limited income and resources. Your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) offers free counseling.
segments.tr: - **支援プログラムについて問い合わせる。** メディケア・セービングス・プログラム、処方薬費用のための「エクストラ・ヘルプ」、および州や地方自治体の支援は、所得や資産が限られている人々を助けることができます。州健康保険援助プログラム（SHIP）では無料のカウンセリングを提供しています。

segments.src: - **Beware of scams.** The SSA does not call to demand payment or threaten to suspend your benefit over a COLA. Use official channels such as ssa.gov and be wary of unsolicited calls, texts, or emails.
segments.tr: - **詐欺に注意する。** SSAが、COLAを理由に支払いを要求したり、給付金の停止を脅したりする電話をかけることはありません。ssa.govなどの公式チャンネルを利用し、不審な電話、テキストメッセージ、メールには十分注意してください。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The COLA is an important protection against inflation, and it adjusts every year without an application.
segments.tr: COLAはインフレに対する重要な保護であり、申請なしで毎年調整されます。

segments.src: But the headline percentage is a starting point, not the final answer.
segments.tr: しかし、見出しのパーセンテージは出発点であり、最終的な答えではありません。

segments.src: What lands in your account depends on Medicare premiums, taxes, and how your own expenses compare with the national index.
segments.tr: 口座に振り込まれる金額は、メディケアの保険料、税金、そして自身の支出が全国平均の指数とどのように比較されるかによって決まります。

segments.src: Review your official notice, compare your net deposit with your real costs, and use the fall enrollment season to look for savings.
segments.tr: 公式通知を確認し、純入金額と実際のコストを比較し、秋のエンロールメントシーズンを利用して節約につなげましょう。

segments.src: A few hours of checking now can make the January change far less of a surprise.
segments.tr: 今、数時間をかけて確認しておくことで、1月の変更による驚きを大幅に減らすことができます。

segments.src: *Figures and rules can change.
segments.tr: *数値やルールは変更される可能性があります。

segments.src: Confirm the current COLA, Medicare premiums, and thresholds with the Social Security Administration (ssa.gov) and Medicare (medicare.gov).*
segments.tr: 現在のCOLA、メディケアの保険料、および閾値について、社会保障局（ssa.gov）およびメディケア（medicare.gov）で確認してください。*
